description.en: Baden-Württemberg , commonly shortened to BW or BaWü, is a landlocked state in Southwest Germany, east of the Rhine, which forms the southern part of the country's western border with France. With more than 11.07 million inhabitants as of 2019 across a total area of nearly 35,752 km2 , it is the third-largest German state by both area and population .
description.zh-CN: 巴登-符騰堡州，通常簡稱為巴符州，是德國西南部的一個州，位於萊茵河以東，巴伐利亚州以西，萊茵河在此形成了德國南部與法國東部的天然邊界。截至2019年，該州擁有超過1107萬居民，總面積近35,752平方公里），在面積和人口上都堪稱德國的第三大州。
description.zh-TW: 巴登-符騰堡州，通常簡稱為巴符州，是德國西南部的一個州，位於萊茵河以東，巴伐利亞州以西，萊茵河在此形成了德國南部與法國東部的天然邊界。截至2019年，該州擁有超過1107萬居民，總面積近35,752平方公里），在面積和人口上都堪稱德國的第三大州。

description.en: Brandenburg, officially the State of Brandenburg , is a landlocked state in northeastern Germany. Brandenburg borders Poland and the states of Berlin, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Lower Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt, and Saxony.
description.zh-CN: 勃兰登堡州是德国东北部的一个州，为前东德的一部分。该州首府和人口最多的城市是波茨坦，其他的重要城市有科特布斯，哈弗尔河畔勃兰登堡和奥得河畔法兰克福。
description.zh-TW: 勃蘭登堡州是德國東北部的一個州，爲前東德的一部分。該州首府和人口最多的城市是波茨坦，其他的重要城市有科特布斯，哈弗爾河畔勃蘭登堡和奧得河畔法蘭克福。

description.en: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern , often known by its anglicised name Mecklenburg–West Pomerania, is a coastal state in the north-east of Germany. Of the country's sixteen states, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern ranks 14th in population; it covers an area of 23,300 km2 , making it the sixth largest German state in area; and it is 16th in population density.
description.zh-CN: 梅克伦堡-前波莫瑞是德国东北部的一个州，為前東德的一部分，1990年两德统一，成為聯邦德國的新邦。它是由原梅克伦堡约三分之二的区域以及西波美拉尼亚，还有普里格尼茨的一小部分地区和北部的乌克马克组成。
description.zh-TW: 梅克倫堡-前波莫瑞是德國東北部的一個州，為前東德的一部分，1990年兩德統一，成為聯邦德國的新邦。它是由原梅克倫堡約三分之二的區域以及西波美拉尼亞，還有普里格尼茨的一小部分地區和北部的烏克馬克組成。

photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Bremen , officially the Free Hanseatic City of Bremen , is the smallest and least populous of Germany's 16 states. It is informally called Land Bremen , although the term is sometimes used in official contexts.
description.zh-CN: 不萊梅汉萨自由市，簡稱不来梅邦，是德國最小的州，也是德國僅有的三個城市州之一，該邦的面積為408km²，位處于威悉河下游及河口，領土包含了與被下薩克森邦分開的相距60km遠的不来梅和不来梅哈芬兩市。不来梅哈芬西臨北海。
description.zh-TW: 不萊梅漢薩自由市，簡稱不來梅邦，是德國最小的州，也是德國僅有的三個城市州之一，該邦的面積為408km²，位處於威悉河下游及河口，領土包含了與被下薩克森邦分開的相距60km遠的不來梅和不來梅哈芬兩市。不來梅哈芬西臨北海。

description.en: Hamburg, officially the Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg, is the second-largest city in Germany after Berlin and sixth-largest city in the European Union, with a population of over 1.9 million. The Hamburg Metropolitan Region has a population of over 5.1 million and is the tenth-largest metropolitan region by GDP in the European Union.

description.en: Berlin is the capital and largest city of Germany. With 3.7 million inhabitants, it has the highest population within its city limits of any city in the European Union .
description.zh-CN: 柏林是德國首都及最大城市，为德国三个城市邦之一；位于德国东北柏林/勃兰登堡大都市区中心部，四面被勃兰登堡州环绕，占地891.85 平方公里，市區內人口约360餘万人。柏林市都會區人口超過460萬，是德國人口最多的城市地區。
description.zh-TW: 柏林是德國首都及最大城市，爲德國三個城市邦之一；位於德國東北柏林/勃蘭登堡大都市區中心部，四面被勃蘭登堡州環繞，佔地891.85 平方公里，市區內人口約360餘萬人。柏林市都會區人口超過460萬，是德國人口最多的城市地區。

description.en: Denmark is a Nordic country in Northern Europe. It is the metropole and most populous constituent of the Kingdom of Denmark, also known as the Danish Realm, a constitutionally unitary state that includes the autonomous territories of the Faroe Islands and Greenland in the north Atlantic Ocean.
description.zh-CN: 丹麦，是位于斯堪的纳维亚最南端的北歐國家，总面积42,943平方公里，在北欧五国中纬度最低，北倚瑞典西南部，挪威南部，南靠與德国北部接壤，是其欧洲部分唯一的陆上边境。丹麦或称丹麦本土，由日德兰半岛北部和菲英岛、西兰岛、北日德兰岛等406个岛屿组成，是丹麦王国的主体部分，也是整个丹麦王国中人口最多，都市区最集中的构成国。
description.zh-TW: 丹麥，是位於斯堪的納維亞最南端的北歐國家，總面積42,943平方公里，在北歐五國中緯度最低，北倚瑞典西南部，挪威南部，南靠與德國北部接壤，是其歐洲部分唯一的陸上邊境。丹麥或稱丹麥本土，由日德蘭半島北部和菲英島、西蘭島、北日德蘭島等406個島嶼組成，是丹麥王國的主體部分，也是整個丹麥王國中人口最多，都市區最集中的構成國。

description.en: Algeria, officially the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria, is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa. It is bordered to the northeast by Tunisia; to the east by Libya; to the southeast by Niger; to the southwest by Mali, Mauritania, and Western Sahara; to the west by Morocco; and to the north by the Mediterranean Sea.
description.zh-CN: 阿爾及利亞民主人民共和國，通稱阿爾及利亞，是北非马格里布地区的一个半总统制共和国，首都及最大城市为阿尔及尔。阿尔及利亚国土北临地中海，东邻利比亚、突尼斯，东南和南部分别与尼日尔、馬利和毛里塔尼亚接壤，西部和摩洛哥相连。
description.zh-TW: 阿爾及利亞民主人民共和國，通稱阿爾及利亞，是北非馬格里布地區的一個半總統制共和國，首都及最大城市爲阿爾及爾。阿爾及利亞國土北臨地中海，東鄰利比亞、突尼斯，東南和南部分別與尼日爾、馬利和毛里塔尼亞接壤，西部和摩洛哥相連。

description.en: Egypt, officially the Arab Republic of Egypt, is a country spanning the northeast corner of Africa and southwest corner of Asia via the Sinai Peninsula. description.en: Akrotiri and Dhekelia , officially the Sovereign Base Areas of Akrotiri and Dhekelia , is a British Overseas Territory that consists of two separate areas on the island of Cyprus. The areas, which include British military bases and installations that were formerly part of the Crown colony of Cyprus, were retained by the British under the 1960 treaty of independence signed by the United Kingdom, Greece, Turkey, the president of Cyprus and the representative of the Turkish Cypriot community.

description.zh-TW: 亞克羅提利與德凱利亞主權基地區是兩個位於地中海極東部島嶼賽普勒斯上的英國特殊屬地，共同組成了英屬基地區，其中亞克羅提利位於賽普勒斯島南部，德凱利亞則位於島上的東南隅。 英屬基地區是一種英國在海外擁有的特殊軍事基地單位。

description.en: Spain, officially the Kingdom of Spain, is a country in Southern and Western Europe with territories in North Africa. Featuring the southernmost point of continental Europe, it is the largest country in Southern Europe and the fourth-most populous European Union member state.
description.zh-CN: 西班牙王国，通稱西班牙，是位於欧洲南部的君主立宪制国家，首都及最大城市为马德里。其大部分领土位于伊比利亚半岛上，占到了伊比利亚半岛总面积之六分之五。

description.en: Ceuta is an autonomous city of Spain on the North African coast. Bordered by Morocco, it lies between the Mediterranean Sea and the Atlantic Ocean.
description.zh-CN: 休达，又称塞卜泰，是西班牙的兩個自治市之一，位于非洲马格里布的最北部，直布罗陀海峡附近的地中海沿岸，与摩洛哥接壤。面积约18.5平方公里。
description.zh-TW: 休達，又稱塞卜泰，是西班牙的兩個自治市之一，位於非洲馬格里布的最北部，直布羅陀海峽附近的地中海沿岸，與摩洛哥接壤。面積約18.5平方公里。

description.en: Melilla is an autonomous city of Spain on the North African coast. It lies on the eastern side of the Cape Three Forks, on the Morocco–Spain border, adjacent to the Moroccan port town of Beni Ansar, and faces the Mediterranean Sea.

description.en: Navarre, officially the Chartered Community of Navarre, is a landlocked foral autonomous community and province in northern Spain, bordering the Basque Autonomous Community, La Rioja, and Aragon in Spain and Nouvelle-Aquitaine in France. The capital city is Pamplona .
description.zh-CN: 纳瓦拉特许共同体，通称纳瓦拉自治区，简称纳瓦拉，是西班牙北部的一個自治區。自治区仅辖纳瓦拉一省，总面积10,391平方千米，2017年总人口643,234。
description.zh-TW: 納瓦拉特許共同體，通稱納瓦拉自治區，簡稱納瓦拉，是西班牙北部的一個自治區。自治區僅轄納瓦拉一省，總面積10,391平方千米，2017年總人口643,234。

description.en: The Basque Country or Basque Autonomous Community, also officially called Euskadi, is an autonomous community in northern Spain. It includes the Basque provinces of Álava , Biscay , and Gipuzkoa .
description.zh-CN: 巴斯克地区自治区，是西班牙中北部的一个自治区，北临比斯开湾，东北隔比利牛斯山脉与法国相邻。西部与坎塔布里亚自治区和卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂自治区相邻。

description.en: Aragon is an autonomous community in Spain, coextensive with the medieval Kingdom of Aragon. In northeastern Spain, the Aragonese autonomous community comprises three provinces : Huesca, Zaragoza, and Teruel.
description.zh-CN: 亞拉岡自治區，通稱亞拉岡，是位於伊比利亞半島東北部的內陸地區，為西班牙的自治區之一，全境面積達47,719平方公里。阿拉贡向北与法国相邻，向东是加泰罗尼亚自治区，向南是巴伦西亚自治区，向西是卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼查自治区、卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂自治区、拉里奥哈自治区和納瓦拉自治區。
description.zh-TW: 亞拉岡自治區，通稱亞拉岡，是位於伊比利亞半島東北部的內陸地區，為西班牙的自治區之一，全境面積達47,719平方公里。阿拉貢向北與法國相鄰，向東是加泰羅尼亞自治區，向南是巴倫西亞自治區，向西是卡斯蒂利亞-拉曼查自治區、卡斯蒂利亞-萊昂自治區、拉里奧哈自治區和納瓦拉自治區。

description.en: Catalonia is an autonomous community of Spain, designated as a nationality by its Statute of Autonomy. Its territory is situated on the northeast of the Iberian Peninsula, to the south of the Pyrenees mountain range.
description.zh-CN: 加泰隆尼亞自治區，通稱加泰隆尼亞，是位於伊比利亞半島東北部的地區，為西班牙的自治區之一，下轄巴塞隆納、萊里達、赫羅納、塔拉戈納等4省，首府為巴塞隆納市。該地區與法國及安道爾接壤，東鄰地中海，全境面積達32,108平方公里。

description.en: Andalusia is the southernmost autonomous community in Peninsular Spain, located in the south of the Iberian Peninsula, in southwestern Europe. With a population of 8,676,713 in an area of 87,598.86 square kilometres as of 2025, it is the most populous and the second-largest autonomous community in the country.
description.zh-CN: 安達魯西亞自治區，通稱安達魯西亞，是位於伊比利亞半島南部的沿海地區，為西班牙的自治區之一，全境面積達87,268平方公里。 安达卢西亚自治区北有埃斯特雷马杜拉自治区和卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼查自治区，东有穆尔西亚自治区，南有地中海、直布罗陀，西有葡萄牙。
description.zh-TW: 安達魯西亞自治區，通稱安達魯西亞，是位於伊比利亞半島南部的沿海地區，為西班牙的自治區之一，全境面積達87,268平方公里。 安達盧西亞自治區北有埃斯特雷馬杜拉自治區和卡斯蒂利亞-拉曼查自治區，東有穆爾西亞自治區，南有地中海、直布羅陀，西有葡萄牙。

description.en: Galicia is an autonomous community of Spain and historic nationality under Spanish law. Located in the northwest Iberian Peninsula, it includes the provinces of A Coruña, Lugo, Ourense, and Pontevedra.
description.zh-CN: 加利西亚自治区是组成西班牙的17个自治区之一，下辖卢戈、奥伦塞、拉科鲁尼亚和蓬特韦德拉4省，首府為圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉。 加利西亚位于西班牙西北部，南部与葡萄牙接壤，东接阿斯图里亚斯和卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂。
description.zh-TW: 加利西亞自治區是組成西班牙的17個自治區之一，下轄盧戈、奧倫塞、拉科魯尼亞和蓬特韋德拉4省，首府為聖地亞哥-德孔波斯特拉。 加利西亞位於西班牙西北部，南部與葡萄牙接壤，東接阿斯圖里亞斯和卡斯蒂利亞-萊昂。

description.en: Castile and León is an autonomous community of Spain. While a capital has not been explicitly declared, the seats of the executive and legislative powers are set in Valladolid by law, and for all purposes that city serves as the de facto regional capital.
description.zh-CN: 卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂自治区是西班牙的自治区，位于西班牙國土西北方，自治區政府駐地為巴利亚多利德，人口2,510,849。卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂的前身是旧卡斯蒂利亚，如今是西班牙面積最大的自治区，也基本上是欧盟最大的自治区。
description.zh-TW: 卡斯蒂利亞-萊昂自治區是西班牙的自治區，位於西班牙國土西北方，自治區政府駐地為巴利亞多利德，人口2,510,849。卡斯蒂利亞-萊昂的前身是舊卡斯蒂利亞，如今是西班牙面積最大的自治區，也基本上是歐盟最大的自治區。

description.en: Murcia is a city in south-eastern Spain, and the capital and most populous city of the autonomous community of the Region of Murcia. As of 2024, with a population of 479,405, it is the 7th-largest city in Spain.
description.zh-CN: 穆尔西亚是西班牙穆尔西亚自治区的首府，西班牙第7大城市。位于西班牙东南部，临塞古拉河和支流瓜达伦廷河。

description.en: Asturias, officially the Principality of Asturias, is an autonomous community in northwestern Spain. It is coextensive with the province of Asturias and contains some of the territory that was part of the larger Kingdom of Asturias in the Middle Ages.
description.zh-CN: 阿斯圖里亞斯自治區 正式名称是阿斯图里亚斯亲王国，是西班牙的一個單省自治區，有過3500年歷史。它北向坎塔布里亚海、南接卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂自治区、西鄰加利西亚自治区、東連坎塔布里亚自治区，总面积达10,604平方公里。
description.zh-TW: 阿斯圖裏亞斯自治區 正式名稱是阿斯圖里亞斯親王國，是西班牙的一個單省自治區，有過3500年歷史。它北向坎塔布里亞海、南接卡斯蒂利亞-萊昂自治區、西鄰加利西亞自治區、東連坎塔布里亞自治區，總面積達10,604平方公里。

description.en: Cantabria is an autonomous community and province in northern Spain with Santander as its capital city. It is called a comunidad histórica, a historic community, in its current statute of autonomy.

description.en: The Canary Islands or Canaries are an archipelago in the Atlantic Ocean and the southernmost autonomous community of Spain, located about 100 kilometres off the northwest coast of Africa. The archipelago has a population of over 2.2 million inhabitants, making it the most populous overseas special territory of the European Union.
description.zh-CN: 加那利群島是一個西班牙的群島及西班牙位置最南的自治區，位于大西洋中，在摩洛哥以西100公里处。该群岛是歐盟特別領域中的外延地区之一，也是西班牙政府认可的八个具有“历史国家”地位的地区之一。

With a population of 1,249,844, they are the 6th least populous autonomous community of Spain, and with an area of 4,991.70 square kilometres , the smallest.

description.en: Madrid is the capital and largest city of Spain. It had a population of over 3.4 million in the city proper in 2025, and a metropolitan area population of approximately 6.8 million.
description.zh-CN: 马德里是西班牙首都及最大都市，也是马德里自治区首府，其位置處於西班牙國土中部，曼薩納雷斯河貫穿市區。2023年，其GDP约为2930亿欧元，市內人口約340萬，都会区人口則約627.1萬，均佔西班牙首位。

description.en: Estonia, officially the Republic of Estonia, is a country in the Baltic region of Northern Europe. It is bordered to the north by the Gulf of Finland across from Finland, to the west by the Baltic Sea across from Sweden, to the south by Latvia, and to the east by Russia.
description.zh-CN: 爱沙尼亚，正式名称为爱沙尼亚共和国，是一个位于北欧或中东欧的国家。其北临芬兰湾，与芬兰隔海相望；西濒波罗的海与瑞典相对；南接拉脱维亚；东邻俄罗斯。
description.zh-TW: 愛沙尼亞，正式名稱爲愛沙尼亞共和國，是一個位於北歐或中東歐的國家。其北臨芬蘭灣，與芬蘭隔海相望；西瀕波羅的海與瑞典相對；南接拉脫維亞；東鄰俄羅斯。

description.en: Estonia, officially the Republic of Estonia, is a country in the Baltic region of Northern Europe. It is bordered to the north by the Gulf of Finland across from Finland, to the west by the Baltic Sea across from Sweden, to the south by Latvia, and to the east by Russia.
description.zh-CN: 爱沙尼亚，正式名称为爱沙尼亚共和国，是一个位于北欧或中东欧的国家。其北临芬兰湾，与芬兰隔海相望；西濒波罗的海与瑞典相对；南接拉脱维亚；东邻俄罗斯。
description.zh-TW: 愛沙尼亞，正式名稱爲愛沙尼亞共和國，是一個位於北歐或中東歐的國家。其北臨芬蘭灣，與芬蘭隔海相望；西瀕波羅的海與瑞典相對；南接拉脫維亞；東鄰俄羅斯。

description.en: Finland, officially the Republic of Finland, is a Nordic country in Northern Europe. It borders Sweden to the northwest, Norway to the north, and Russia to the east, with the Gulf of Bothnia to the west and the Gulf of Finland to the south, opposite Estonia.
description.zh-CN: 芬兰，全称芬兰共和国，是位于北欧的沿海国家。其西北与瑞典北博滕省接壤，北接挪威特罗姆斯郡和芬马克郡，东部分别与俄罗斯的摩尔曼斯克州、卡累利阿共和国和列宁格勒州相邻；西濒波的尼亚湾，南临芬兰湾，与爱沙尼亚隔海相望。
description.zh-TW: 芬蘭，全稱芬蘭共和國，是位於北歐的沿海國家。其西北與瑞典北博滕省接壤，北接挪威特羅姆斯郡和芬馬克郡，東部分別與俄羅斯的摩爾曼斯克州、卡累利阿共和國和列寧格勒州相鄰；西瀕波的尼亞灣，南臨芬蘭灣，與愛沙尼亞隔海相望。

description.en: France, officially the French Republic, is a country primarily located in Western Europe. Its overseas regions and territories include French Guiana in South America, Saint Pierre and Miquelon in the North Atlantic, the French West Indies, and many islands in Oceania and the Indian Ocean.
description.zh-CN: 法蘭西共和國，通稱法國，是位于西歐的半總統制共和國，東鄰德國、比利時與義大利，西面比斯開灣，西南接西班牙，北隔英吉利海峽與英國相望。人口6789萬人，首都巴黎。

description.en: Hauts-de-France , also referred to in English as Upper France, is the northernmost region of France, created by the territorial reform of French regions in 2014, from a merger of Nord-Pas-de-Calais and Picardy. Its prefecture is Lille.
description.zh-CN: 上法蘭西大區是法国的一个大区，其根據2014年大區重劃由北部-加來海峽、皮卡第兩個大區合併而成，2016年1月1日起生效。
description.zh-TW: 上法蘭西大區是法國的一個大區，其根據2014年大區重劃由北部-加來海峽、皮卡第兩個大區合併而成，2016年1月1日起生效。

description.en: Grand Est is one of France's landlocked administrative regions, this being in northeastern France. It superseded three former administrative regions, Alsace, Champagne-Ardenne, and Lorraine, on 1 January 2016 under the provisional name of Alsace-Champagne-Ardenne-Lorraine as a result of territorial reform which had been passed by the French Parliament in 2014.

description.zh-TW: 大東部是法國的大區之一，由阿爾薩斯、香檳-阿登、洛林3個大區合併而成，於2016年1月1日正式成立、同年9月28日改用現名。

description.en: Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur , sometimes known as Région Sud, is one of the eighteen administrative regions of France, located at the far southeastern point of the mainland. The main prefecture and largest city is Marseille, France's second largest city proper after Paris and the 2nd largest urban area when combined with Aix-en-Provence with over 1.9 million residents.
description.zh-CN: 普罗旺斯-阿尔卑斯-蔚蓝海岸大区，简称普阿蓝大区，是法国東南部的一個大區，首府马赛。 普阿蓝大区南鄰地中海，面积31,400平方公里，人口4,506,151人。

description.en: Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes is a landlocked region in Southern France. It was created by the 2014 territorial reform of French regions; it resulted from the merger of Auvergne and Rhône-Alpes.
description.zh-CN: 奧弗涅-羅訥-阿爾卑斯，简称奥罗阿大区，是法國的一个大區，首府里昂。奥罗阿大区是根據2014年大區重劃规划，合併了奥弗涅、罗讷-阿尔卑斯兩個大區的新大区，已于2016年1月1日起生效。
description.zh-TW: 奧弗涅-羅訥-阿爾卑斯，簡稱奧羅阿大區，是法國的一個大區，首府里昂。奧羅阿大區是根據2014年大區重劃規劃，合併了奧弗涅、羅訥-阿爾卑斯兩個大區的新大區，已於2016年1月1日起生效。

description.en: Nouvelle-Aquitaine is the largest administrative region in France by area, located in the west and southwest of Metropolitan France. It was created in 2014 from the merger of Aquitaine, Limousin, and Poitou-Charentes in a territorial reform.
description.zh-CN: 新阿基坦是法國的一个大區，根據2014年大區重劃，合併阿基坦、利穆赞、普瓦图-夏朗德等三個大區而来，2016年1月1日起生效。首府與最大城市為波爾多。
description.zh-TW: 新阿基坦是法國的一個大區，根據2014年大區重劃，合併阿基坦、利穆贊、普瓦圖-夏朗德等三個大區而來，2016年1月1日起生效。首府與最大城市為波爾多。

photo.alt: Les chateaux et manoirs du Perigord, le chateau de La Roque en Perigord noir, ici vue d’ensemble N.E. en automne, le chateau est bati a mi coteau au-dessus d’un vallon au N.E. de Saint-Cyprien, juchee a l’extremite d’une etroite terrasse la construction s’est developpee en hauteur ce qui lui confere sa silhouette massive et imposante, les Beaumont-Beynac vendirent le chateau en 1948, il a depuis lors connu divers proprietaires et fut du XVIIIe siecle jusqu’a nos jours incessamment remanie, embelli, modernise et amenage en residence confortable, on a heureusement preserve le remarquable ensemble de fresques decorant l’oratoire, edifice protege au titre des monuments historiques, photo prise apres avoir obtenu l’autorisation du proprietaire, commune de Meyrals, Dordogne, France, Europe.

description.en: Occitania is the southernmost administrative region of metropolitan France excluding Corsica, located in the south of the country, created on 1 January 2016 from the former regions of Languedoc-Roussillon and Midi-Pyrénées. The Council of State approved Occitania as the new name of the region on 28 September 2016, coming into effect on 30 September 2016.
description.zh-CN: 奥克西塔尼大区是法国的一级行政区划单位大区，于2016年1月1日正式成立，并于同年9月28日正式命名。该大区由原来的朗格多克-鲁西永和南比利牛斯两个大区合并而成。
description.zh-TW: 奧克西塔尼大區是法國的一級行政區劃單位大區，於2016年1月1日正式成立，並於同年9月28日正式命名。該大區由原來的朗格多克-魯西永和南比利牛斯兩個大區合併而成。

description.en: Bourgogne-Franche-Comté is a region in France created by the 2014 territorial reform of French regions, from a merger of Burgundy and Franche-Comté. The new region came into existence on 1 January 2016, after the regional elections of December 2015, electing 100 members to the Regional Council of Bourgogne-Franche-Comté.
description.zh-CN: 勃艮第-弗朗什-孔泰是法国的一个大區，首府第戎，根據2014年大區重劃，由原弗朗什-孔泰、勃艮第兩個大區合并而成，2016年1月1日起生效。

description.en: Pays de la Loire is one of the eighteen administrative regions of France, located on the country's Atlantic coast. It was created in the 1950s to serve as a zone of influence for its capital and most populated city, Nantes, one of a handful of French "balancing metropolises" .
description.zh-CN: 卢瓦尔河地区大区是法国西部一個大區，西鄰大西洋，处于卢瓦尔河下游和及河口地区，法国大革命时期曾是保皇派叛乱的重要区域。它是1950年代创建的大区之一，作为其首府的影响区，南特是少数所谓的“平衡大都会”之一。
description.zh-TW: 盧瓦爾河地區大區是法國西部一個大區，西鄰大西洋，處於盧瓦爾河下游和及河口地區，法國大革命時期曾是保皇派叛亂的重要區域。它是1950年代創建的大區之一，作爲其首府的影響區，南特是少數所謂的“平衡大都會”之一。

description.en: Brittany is a peninsula, historical region and cultural area in the north-west of modern France, covering the western part of what was known as Armorica in Roman Gaul. It became an independent kingdom and then a duchy before being united with the Kingdom of France in 1532 as a province governed as a separate nation under the crown.
description.zh-CN: 布列塔尼半岛是法国西北部的一個半岛，歷史上文化及行政上的一個地區名稱。布列塔尼半岛位于阿摩里卡西部，北部面向英倫海峽，南部對着比斯開灣。
description.zh-TW: 布列塔尼半島是法國西北部的一個半島，歷史上文化及行政上的一個地區名稱。布列塔尼半島位於阿摩裏卡西部，北部面向英倫海峽，南部對着比斯開灣。

description.en: Normandy is a geographical and cultural region in northwestern Europe, roughly coextensive with the historical Duchy of Normandy. Normandy comprises mainland Normandy and insular Normandy .
description.zh-CN: 诺曼底是法国西北部的一个地理和文化区域，濒临英吉利海峡，与历史上的諾曼第公國范围大致相同。 诺曼底包括大陆诺曼底和岛屿诺曼底。
description.zh-TW: 諾曼底是法國西北部的一個地理和文化區域，瀕臨英吉利海峽，與歷史上的諾曼第公國範圍大致相同。 諾曼底包括大陸諾曼底和島嶼諾曼底。

description.en: Corsica is an island in the Mediterranean Sea and one of the 18 regions of France. It is the fourth-largest island in the Mediterranean and lies southeast of the French mainland, west of the Italian Peninsula and immediately north of the Italian island of Sardinia, the nearest land mass.
description.zh-CN: 科西嘉是地中海西部的一座岛屿，也是法国的一个单一领土集体及18个大区之一，位于法国大陆部分的东南面，意大利半島的西面，最临近的地块是撒丁岛。科西嘉岛三分之二的部分由一条山脉构成。
description.zh-TW: 科西嘉是地中海西部的一座島嶼，也是法國的一個單一領土集體及18個大區之一，位於法國大陸部分的東南面，意大利半島的西面，最臨近的地塊是撒丁島。科西嘉島三分之二的部分由一條山脈構成。

description.en: Centre-Val de Loire , or simply Centre as it was known until 2015, is one of the eighteen administrative regions of France and one of five without a coastline. It straddles the middle Loire Valley in the interior of the country, encompassing six departments , with a population of 2,572,853 as of 2018.
description.zh-CN: 中央-盧瓦爾河谷是法国中部的一個大區。中部地区处在风景秀丽的卢瓦尔河谷地区，很久以前便是法国王室的直辖地，和法兰西岛一样是法语的发源地，有人认为这一地区有着“最标准的法语”。
description.zh-TW: 中央-盧瓦爾河谷是法國中部的一個大區。中部地區處在風景秀麗的盧瓦爾河谷地區，很久以前便是法國王室的直轄地，和法蘭西島一樣是法語的發源地，有人認爲這一地區有着“最標準的法語”。

description.en: The Île-de-France is the most populous of the eighteen regions of France, with an official estimated population of 12,271,794 residents on 1 January 2023. Containing the capital city of France, Paris, it is located in the north-central part of the country and often called the Paris Region .
description.zh-CN: 法兰西岛是法国本土13个大区之一，也是法國首都巴黎的首都圈。其以巴黎为中心，包括巴黎省、上塞纳省、塞纳-圣但尼省、马恩河谷省、塞纳-马恩省、伊夫林省、埃松省和瓦兹河谷省，共计1276个市镇。

description.en: The Faroe Islands , also known as the Faroes, are an archipelago in the North Atlantic Ocean and a rigsdel of the Kingdom of Denmark. description.en: The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, commonly known as the United Kingdom or Britain, is a country in Northwestern Europe, off the coast of the continental mainland. It comprises England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, with a population of over 69 million in 2025.
description.zh-CN: 大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国，簡稱联合王国或不列颠，通稱英国，是位於西歐的國家，地理範圍包括大不列颠岛、北爱尔兰及一系列小岛屿。英国由大西洋所环抱，东面北海，南與歐洲大陸隔英吉利海峽相望，西南偏南为凱爾特海，大不列顛本土西側與爱尔兰島隔愛爾蘭海。
description.zh-TW: 大不列顛及北愛爾蘭聯合王國，簡稱聯合王國或不列顛，通稱英國，是位於西歐的國家，地理範圍包括大不列顛島、北愛爾蘭及一系列小島嶼。英國由大西洋所環抱，東面北海，南與歐洲大陸隔英吉利海峽相望，西南偏南爲凱爾特海，大不列顛本土西側與愛爾蘭島隔愛爾蘭海。

photo.alt: Cambridge Science Park Napp Pharmaceutical Group building in April 2011.

description.en: Northern Ireland is a part of the United Kingdom in the north-east of the island of Ireland. It has been variously described as a country, province or region.
description.zh-CN: 北愛爾蘭是英國的組成部分，位于爱尔兰岛东北部，擁有國家、省、地區這些不同的術語稱呼。北愛爾蘭的西部和南部與愛爾蘭共和國保持著邊境開放。
description.zh-TW: 北愛爾蘭是英國的組成部分，位於愛爾蘭島東北部，擁有國家、省、地區這些不同的術語稱呼。北愛爾蘭的西部和南部與愛爾蘭共和國保持著邊境開放。

photo.alt: Belfast City Hall, Belfast, Northern Ireland, October 2010 (viewed from inside the Linen Hall Library)

description.en: West Wales and the Valleys is a former statistical grouping joining western Wales with the South Wales Valleys. It was used to organise regional development funding; its map outline is a statistical geography rather than a distinct cultural border.
description.zh-CN: 西威尔士与山谷地带是一个较早的统计分组，将威尔士西部与南威尔士诸山谷合在一起，曾用于地区发展资金的规划。图中的范围属于统计地理，不应被理解为独立的文化边界。
description.zh-TW: 西威爾士與山谷地帶是一個較早的統計分組，將威爾士西部與南威爾士諸山谷合在一起，曾用於地區發展資金的規劃。圖中的範圍屬於統計地理，不應被理解為獨立的文化邊界。

description.en: North West England is one of nine official regions of England and consists of the ceremonial counties of Cheshire, Cumbria, Greater Manchester, Lancashire and Merseyside. The North West had a population of 7,417,397 in 2021.
description.zh-CN: 西北英格蘭是英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一，主要以重工業城市為主，包括曼徹斯特、利物浦等等，瀕臨西面的大西洋。工業革命時代主要以製造業為主，同時是造船基地。

description.en: South West England, or the South West of England, is one of the nine official regions of England in the United Kingdom. Additionally, it is one of four regions that altogether make up Southern England.

description.en: North East England is one of nine official regions of England. It consists of County Durham, Northumberland, Tyne and Wear and part of North Yorkshire.

description.en: This older Scottish statistical grouping joins Glasgow and the Clyde area with Ayrshire, Lanarkshire and Dumfries and Galloway. It spans the urban west-central belt and the more rural south-west; its historical statistical outline should not be read as a cultural frontier.
description.zh-CN: 这一较早的苏格兰统计分区，将格拉斯哥与克莱德河一带，同艾尔郡、拉纳克郡及邓弗里斯和加洛韦相连。范围横跨西部中央地带的城镇与西南部乡野；图中的旧统计边界不是文化界线。
description.zh-TW: 這一較早的蘇格蘭統計分區，將格拉斯哥與克萊德河一帶，同艾爾郡、拉納克郡及鄧弗里斯和加洛韋相連。範圍橫跨西部中央地帶的城鎮與西南部鄉野；圖中的舊統計邊界不是文化界線。

photo.alt: Built to replace All Hallows Church which was destroyed in the Great Fire of Northampton 1675. Charles II gave 1000 tons of timber to rebuild the town, of which 10 per cent was used to build All Saints. The tower of All Hallows survived and was incorporated into Henry Bell's Christopher Wren-influenced new design, which also includes a dome supported on Ionic columns and a barrel-vaulted nave. The church was consecrated in 1680 and the portico was added in 1701, along with a statue of King Charles. On Oak Apple Day each year the statue is adorned with a wreath of oak leaves.

description.en: Eastern Scotland links the Firth of Forth and Fife with the Tay basin, Angus and the eastern Lowlands. This atlas retains the older statistical grouping, including Edinburgh, Stirling and the Scottish Borders, rather than presenting it as a single cultural boundary.
description.zh-CN: 苏格兰东部连接福斯湾、法夫、泰河流域与东部低地。这幅图沿用较早的统计分区，范围包括爱丁堡、斯特灵及苏格兰边区；它并不代表一条单一文化边界。海湾、河谷与低地城镇构成了这一带的主要地理线索。
description.zh-TW: 蘇格蘭東部連接福斯灣、法夫、泰河流域與東部低地。這幅圖沿用較早的統計分區，範圍包括愛丁堡、斯特靈及蘇格蘭邊區；它並不代表一條單一文化邊界。海灣、河谷與低地城鎮構成了這一帶的主要地理線索。

description.en: Greater London is an administrative area in England, coterminous with the London region, containing most of the continuous urban area of London. It contains 33 local government districts: the 32 London boroughs, which form a ceremonial county also called Greater London, and the City of London, which is a separate ceremonial county.
description.zh-CN: 大倫敦，位於英國英格蘭東南部，是英格蘭下屬的一級行政區劃之一，範圍大致包含英國首都倫敦首都直轄市與其周圍的衛星城鎮所組成的都會區。行政上，該區域是依據1965年施行的《1963年倫敦政府法令》設置，其下包含倫敦市與32個倫敦自治市，共33個次級行政區。

description.en: Guernsey is the second-largest island in the Channel Islands, located 27 miles west of the Cotentin Peninsula, Normandy. It is the largest island in the Bailiwick of Guernsey, which includes five other inhabited islands – Alderney, Herm, Jethou, Brecqhou and Sark – and many small islets and rocks.

description.en: Gibraltar is a British Overseas Territory and city located near the southern tip of the Iberian Peninsula, on the Bay of Gibraltar, near the exit of the Mediterranean Sea into the Atlantic Ocean . It has an area of 6.8 km2 and is bordered to the north by Spain .

description.en: Croatia, officially the Republic of Croatia, is a country in Central and Southeastern Europe, on the coast of the Adriatic Sea. description.en: The Isle of Man , also known simply as Man or Mann , is a self-governing British Crown Dependency in the Irish Sea, between Great Britain and Ireland. As head of state, Charles III holds the title Lord of Mann and is represented by a Lieutenant Governor.

description.en: Ireland is an island in the North Atlantic Ocean, in Northwestern Europe. Geopolitically, the island is divided between the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland .
description.zh-CN: 爱尔兰岛是位於欧洲西北部的大西洋島嶼，以面積計算是歐洲第三大島。島上大部分區域屬於爱尔兰共和国的領土，至於島上東北部的北愛爾蘭地區之主權則屬於英国。
description.zh-TW: 愛爾蘭島是位於歐洲西北部的大西洋島嶼，以面積計算是歐洲第三大島。島上大部分區域屬於愛爾蘭共和國的領土，至於島上東北部的北愛爾蘭地區之主權則屬於英國。

photo.alt: It is easy to see from this true-colour image why Ireland is called the Emerald Isle. Intense green vegetation, primarily grassland, covers most of the country except for the exposed rock on mountaintops. Ireland owes its greenness to moderate temperatures and moist air. The Atlantic Ocean, particularly the warm currents in the North Atlantic Drift, gives the country a more temperate climate than most others at the same latitude.

description.en: Iceland is a Nordic island country between the Arctic Ocean and the North Atlantic Ocean, located on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge between Europe and North America. It is Europe's westernmost and most sparsely populated country.
description.zh-CN: 冰岛是北欧的一个共和制岛国，位于北大西洋和北冰洋交汇处。冰岛国土面积为10.3万平方公里，人口为39万，儘管面積不大，卻是欧洲人口密度最低的国家，也是世界范围内人口密度很小的国家之一。
description.zh-TW: 冰島是北歐的一個共和制島國，位於北大西洋和北冰洋交匯處。冰島國土面積爲10.3萬平方公里，人口爲39萬，儘管面積不大，卻是歐洲人口密度最低的國家，也是世界範圍內人口密度很小的國家之一。

description.en: Israel, officially the State of Israel, is a country in the Southern Levant region of West Asia. It is bordered by Lebanon to the north, Syria to the northeast, Jordan to the east, and Egypt to the southwest.
description.zh-CN: 以色列国，通稱以色列，是一个位于西亚的国家。其北邻黎巴嫩，东北接叙利亚，东接约旦，西南与埃及接壤，西濒地中海。
description.zh-TW: 以色列國，通稱以色列，是一個位於西亞的國家。其北鄰黎巴嫩，東北接敘利亞，東接約旦，西南與埃及接壤，西瀕地中海。

description.en: Italy, officially the Italian Republic, is a country in Southern and Western Europe. It consists of a peninsula, which extends into the Mediterranean Sea, with the Alps on its northern land border, as well as nearly 800 islands, notably Sicily and Sardinia.
description.zh-CN: 意大利共和國，簡稱意大利，是位於歐洲南部的議會制民主共和國，主要由位於南歐地中海邊呈靴型的亞平寧半島、西西里島、薩丁尼亞島和一些地中海內的小島嶼組成。首都為羅馬。
description.zh-TW: 意大利共和國，簡稱意大利，是位於歐洲南部的議會制民主共和國，主要由位於南歐地中海邊呈靴型的亞平寧半島、西西里島、薩丁尼亞島和一些地中海內的小島嶼組成。首都為羅馬。

description.en: The Aosta Valley , officially the Autonomous Region of Aosta Valley, is a mountainous autonomous region of northwestern Italy. It is bordered by Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, France, to the west; by Valais, Switzerland, to the north; and by Piedmont, Italy, to the south and east.
description.zh-CN: 瓦莱达奥斯塔，是意大利西北部的一个特殊地位大区，其西临法国奥弗涅-罗讷-阿尔卑斯大区，北方与瑞士瓦莱州接壤，东南邻皮埃蒙特大区。大区首府为奥斯塔。
description.zh-TW: 瓦萊達奧斯塔，是意大利西北部的一個特殊地位大區，其西臨法國奧弗涅-羅訥-阿爾卑斯大區，北方與瑞士瓦萊州接壤，東南鄰皮埃蒙特大區。大區首府爲奧斯塔。

description.en: Piedmont is one of the 20 regions of Italy, located in the Northwest of the country. It borders the Liguria region to the south, the Lombardy and Emilia-Romagna regions to the east, and the Aosta Valley region to the northwest.
description.zh-CN: 皮埃蒙特是意大利西北的一个大区，面积25,402平方公里，人口數4,377,941，首府是都灵。 皮埃蒙特大区的三面被阿尔卑斯山山脉包围，包括波河的起源维素山脉，及罗莎山脉。
description.zh-TW: 皮埃蒙特是意大利西北的一個大區，面積25,402平方公里，人口數4,377,941，首府是都靈。 皮埃蒙特大區的三面被阿爾卑斯山山脈包圍，包括波河的起源維素山脈，及羅莎山脈。

description.en: Lombardy is an administrative region of Italy that covers 23,844 km2 ; it is located in northern Italy and with a population of about 10 million is the most populous region, constituting more than one-sixth of Italy's population.
description.zh-CN: 伦巴第是一个位于阿尔卑斯山和波河的一个意大利北部大区。它与意大利的其它大区皮埃蒙特、艾米利亚-罗马涅、威尼托、特伦蒂诺-上阿迪杰以及瑞士相接。
description.zh-TW: 倫巴第是一個位於阿爾卑斯山和波河的一個意大利北部大區。它與意大利的其它大區皮埃蒙特、艾米利亞-羅馬涅、威尼託、特倫蒂諾-上阿迪傑以及瑞士相接。

description.en: Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol , often known in English as Trentino-South Tyrol or by its Italian name Trentino-Alto Adige, is an autonomous region of Italy, located in the northern part of the country. The region has a population of nearly 1.1 million, of whom 62% speak Italian as their mother tongue , 30% speak German , and the remaining are minority speakers of Ladin, Mòcheno or Cimbrian and immigrant communities speaking several foreign languages.
description.zh-CN: 特伦蒂诺-上阿迪杰，德语与拉定语称特伦蒂诺-南蒂罗尔，正式名称为特伦蒂诺-上阿迪杰/南蒂罗尔，是意大利北部的一个特殊地位大区。该自治区由两个分区组成，分别是多数人说意大利语的特伦托省及多数人说德语的南蒂罗尔省。
description.zh-TW: 特倫蒂諾-上阿迪傑，德語與拉定語稱特倫蒂諾-南蒂羅爾，正式名稱爲特倫蒂諾-上阿迪傑/南蒂羅爾，是意大利北部的一個特殊地位大區。該自治區由兩個分區組成，分別是多數人說意大利語的特倫託省及多數人說德語的南蒂羅爾省。

photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Liguria is a region of north-western Italy; its capital is Genoa. Its territory is crossed by the Alps and the Apennines mountain range and is roughly coextensive with the former territory of the Republic of Genoa.
description.zh-CN: 利古里亚是意大利西北部的一个邻海大区，是意大利众大区中第三小的。大区西临法国，北界与皮埃蒙特大区相邻，东临艾米利亚-罗马涅大区及托斯卡纳大区。
description.zh-TW: 利古里亞是意大利西北部的一個鄰海大區，是意大利衆大區中第三小的。大區西臨法國，北界與皮埃蒙特大區相鄰，東臨艾米利亞-羅馬涅大區及托斯卡納大區。

description.en: Emilia-Romagna is an administrative region of northern Italy, comprising the historical regions of Emilia and Romagna. Its capital is Bologna.
description.zh-CN: 艾米利亚-罗马涅是位于意大利北部的大区，由历史上的两个大区艾米利亚和罗马涅组成。辖区形状如三角形，东临亚得里亚海，北界隔波河与伦巴第大区和威尼托大区毗邻，西临皮埃蒙特和利古里亚大区，托斯卡纳大区、马尔凯大区和圣马力诺共和国位于其南部。
description.zh-TW: 艾米利亞-羅馬涅是位於意大利北部的大區，由歷史上的兩個大區艾米利亞和羅馬涅組成。轄區形狀如三角形，東臨亞得里亞海，北界隔波河與倫巴第大區和威尼託大區毗鄰，西臨皮埃蒙特和利古里亞大區，托斯卡納大區、馬爾凱大區和聖馬力諾共和國位於其南部。

description.en: Marche , in English sometimes referred to as the Marches , is one of the twenty regions of Italy. The region is located in the central area of the country, and has a population of nearly 1.5 million people, being the thirteenth largest region in the country by number of inhabitants.
description.zh-CN: 马尔凯是意大利中部的一个大区，北界与艾米利亚-罗马涅大区相邻，西北为托斯卡纳大区，西邻翁布里亚大区，南邻阿布鲁佐大区和拉齐奥大区，而东面则有亚得里亚海。 大区的首府是安科纳。
description.zh-TW: 馬爾凱是意大利中部的一個大區，北界與艾米利亞-羅馬涅大區相鄰，西北爲托斯卡納大區，西鄰翁布里亞大區，南鄰阿布魯佐大區和拉齊奧大區，而東面則有亞得里亞海。 大區的首府是安科納。

description.en: Veneto, officially the Region of Veneto, is one of the 20 regions of Italy, located in the north-east of the country. It is the 4th most populous region in Italy, with a population of 4,857,460 as of 2026.
description.zh-CN: 威尼托是意大利东北部的一个大区，人口約500萬，在意大利排名第四。其边界与伦巴第、特伦蒂诺-上阿迪杰、奥地利、弗留利-威尼斯朱利亚和艾米利亚-罗马涅接壤，在阿尔卑斯山和亚得里亚海之间。
description.zh-TW: 威尼託是意大利東北部的一個大區，人口約500萬，在意大利排名第四。其邊界與倫巴第、特倫蒂諾-上阿迪傑、奧地利、弗留利-威尼斯朱利亞和艾米利亞-羅馬涅接壤，在阿爾卑斯山和亞得里亞海之間。

description.en: Friuli-Venezia Giulia is one of the 20 regions of Italy and one of five autonomous regions with special statute. The regional capital is Trieste on the Gulf of Trieste, a bay of the Adriatic Sea.
description.zh-CN: 弗留利-威尼斯朱利亚，面积7856km²，人口118万，是意大利东北部的一个大区，也是意大利5个特殊地位大区之一，毗邻威尼托大区、奥地利、斯洛文尼亚和亚得里亚海。主要城市是的里雅斯特和乌迪内。
description.zh-TW: 弗留利-威尼斯朱利亞，面積7856km²，人口118萬，是意大利東北部的一個大區，也是意大利5個特殊地位大區之一，毗鄰威尼託大區、奧地利、斯洛文尼亞和亞得里亞海。主要城市是的裏雅斯特和烏迪內。

photo.alt: Cividale del Friuli in northern Italy is an old town with a medieval center. It was once the capital of the kingdom of the Lombards. Cividale is situated on the river Natisone.

description.en: Abruzzo , historically also known as Abruzzi, is a region of Southern Italy. It has a population of nearly 1.3 million in an area of 10,831.84 square kilometres .
description.zh-CN: 阿布鲁佐是位于意大利中南部的大区，北与马尔凯交接，拉齐奥位于其西南，东南部是莫利塞大区，东边则是亚得里亚海。该区于1963年从原阿布鲁齐-莫利塞大区中划分出来。
description.zh-TW: 阿布魯佐是位於意大利中南部的大區，北與馬爾凱交接，拉齊奧位於其西南，東南部是莫利塞大區，東邊則是亞得里亞海。該區於1963年從原阿布魯齊-莫利塞大區中劃分出來。

description.en: Molise is an administrative region of Italy that covers 4,460.65 km2 , thus being the second smallest region in the country after Aosta Valley; it is located in southern Italy, and has a population of 285,940 as of 2026. Its regional capital and largest city is Campobasso, which is also the capital of the Province of Campobasso, one of the two provinces that make up Molise.
description.zh-CN: 莫利塞是意大利中部的一个大区，是意大利第二小的大区。大区的前身是阿布魯齊莫利塞區的一部分，现时已分成两个个别的大区。
description.zh-TW: 莫利塞是意大利中部的一個大區，是意大利第二小的大區。大區的前身是阿布魯齊莫利塞區的一部分，現時已分成兩個個別的大區。

description.en: Apulia , also known by its Italian name Puglia , is one of the 20 regions of Italy, located in the southern peninsular section of the country, bordering the Adriatic Sea to the east, the Strait of Otranto and Ionian Sea to the southeast and the Gulf of Taranto to the south. The region comprises 19,540.90 square kilometers , and has 3,865,277 inhabitants as of 2026.
description.zh-CN: 普利亚，也译作阿普利亚，是意大利南部的一个大区，东邻亚得里亚海，东南面临爱奥尼亚海，南面则邻近奥特朗托海峡及塔兰托湾。该区南部知名的萨伦托半岛，组成了意大利「皮靴」的一部分。
description.zh-TW: 普利亞，也譯作阿普利亞，是意大利南部的一個大區，東鄰亞得里亞海，東南面臨愛奧尼亞海，南面則鄰近奧特朗托海峽及塔蘭託灣。該區南部知名的薩倫託半島，組成了意大利「皮靴」的一部分。

photo.credit: NASA / USGS · Landsat WELD · 2000 · Public domain

description.en: Basilicata, also known by its ancient name Lucania, is an administrative region in Southern Italy, bordering on Campania to the west, Apulia to the north and east, and Calabria to the south. It has two coastlines: a 30-kilometre stretch on the Gulf of Policastro between Campania and Calabria, and a longer coastline along the Gulf of Taranto between Calabria and Apulia.
description.zh-CN: 巴西利卡塔亦称卢卡尼亚，是意大利南部的一个大区，东、西分别与坎帕尼亚、普利亚相邻，南边是卡拉布里亚，有小段海岸线连接第勒尼安海，另一段则在东南方—塔兰托湾—与伊奥尼亚海相连。全区面积9,995平方公里，人口597,768，人口密度为60人/平方公里。
description.zh-TW: 巴西利卡塔亦稱盧卡尼亞，是意大利南部的一個大區，東、西分別與坎帕尼亞、普利亞相鄰，南邊是卡拉布里亞，有小段海岸線連接第勒尼安海，另一段則在東南方—塔蘭託灣—與伊奧尼亞海相連。全區面積9,995平方公里，人口597,768，人口密度爲60人/平方公里。

photo.alt: The Temple of Hera at Metapontum
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Calabria is a region in Southern Italy. It is a peninsula bordered by the Basilicata region to the north, the Ionian Sea to the east, the Strait of Messina to the southwest, which separates it from Sicily, and the Tyrrhenian Sea to the west.
description.zh-CN: 卡拉布里亚，從前稱為“布鲁提乌姆”，是意大利南部的一個大区，包含了那不勒斯以南像「足尖」的意大利半島。大区北鄰巴西利卡塔大区，西南鄰西西里自治区，西鄰第勒尼安海，及東鄰伊奧尼亞海。
description.zh-TW: 卡拉布里亞，從前稱為“布魯提烏姆”，是意大利南部的一個大區，包含了那不勒斯以南像「足尖」的意大利半島。大區北鄰巴西利卡塔大區，西南鄰西西里自治區，西鄰第勒尼安海，及東鄰伊奧尼亞海。

description.en: Sicily , officially the Sicilian Region, is an island in the central Mediterranean Sea and one of the twenty regions of Italy, situated south of the Italian Peninsula in continental Europe. With over 4.7 million inhabitants, including 1.2 million in and around the capital city of Palermo, it is both the largest and most populous island in the Mediterranean Sea.

description.en: Sardinia , officially the Autonomous Region of Sardinia, is the second largest island in the Mediterranean Sea after Sicily, and one of the twenty regions of Italy. description.en: Jersey , officially the Bailiwick of Jersey, is an autonomous and self-governing British Crown Dependency in Northwestern Europe 14 miles off the Cotentin Peninsula of north-west France. At 45 square miles , the main island, Jersey, is the largest of the Channel Islands.

It is one of three Baltic states and lies on the eastern shore of the Baltic Sea, bordered by Latvia to the north, Belarus to the east and south, Poland to the south, and the Russian semi-exclave of Kaliningrad Oblast to the southwest, with a maritime border with Sweden to the west.

description.en: Luxembourg, officially the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, is a landlocked country in Western Europe. It is bordered by Belgium to the west and north, Germany to the east, and France to the south.

description.en: Morocco, officially the Kingdom of Morocco, is a country in North Africa. It has coastlines on the Mediterranean Sea to the north and the Atlantic Ocean to the west, and has land borders with Algeria to the east; the Spanish exclaves of Ceuta, Melilla and Peñón de Vélez de la Gomera along the north, which it claims together with several small Spanish-controlled islands; and the disputed territory of Western Sahara to the south, partly occupied by Morocco since 1975.
description.zh-CN: 摩洛哥王国，通稱摩洛哥，是北非西端马格里布的一个君主立宪制国家。其东部与阿尔及利亚接壤，南部其实际管辖的西撒哈拉地区与毛里塔尼亚紧邻，西部滨临大西洋，并向北隔直布罗陀海峡和地中海与葡萄牙、西班牙相望。
description.zh-TW: 摩洛哥王國，通稱摩洛哥，是北非西端馬格里布的一個君主立憲制國家。其東部與阿爾及利亞接壤，南部其實際管轄的西撒哈拉地區與毛里塔尼亞緊鄰，西部濱臨大西洋，並向北隔直布羅陀海峽和地中海與葡萄牙、西班牙相望。

description.en: Monaco, officially the Principality of Monaco, is a sovereign city-state and microstate in Western Europe. Situated on the French Riviera, it is a semi-enclave bordered by France to the north, east, and west, with the Mediterranean Sea to the south; the Italian region of Liguria is about 15 km east.
description.zh-CN: 摩納哥公國，又称摩纳哥大公国、摩纳哥亲王国，通稱摩納哥，是一个位于西欧或南歐的城邦。摩納哥地处法国南部，除了靠地中海的南部海岸線之外，全境北、西、東三面皆由法國包圍，主要是由摩纳哥旧城和随后建立起来的週遭地区组成。
description.zh-TW: 摩納哥公國，又稱摩納哥大公國、摩納哥親王國，通稱摩納哥，是一個位於西歐或南歐的城邦。摩納哥地處法國南部，除了靠地中海的南部海岸線之外，全境北、西、東三面皆由法國包圍，主要是由摩納哥舊城和隨後建立起來的週遭地區組成。

description.en: Moldova, officially the Republic of Moldova, is a landlocked country in Eastern Europe, with an area of 33,843 km2 and a population of 2.38 million. Moldova is bordered by Romania to the west and Ukraine to the north, east, and south.

description.en: Mexico, officially the United Mexican States, is a country in North America. It is the northernmost country in Latin America, bordering the United States of America to the north and Guatemala and Belize to the southeast, while having maritime boundaries with the Pacific Ocean to the west, the Caribbean Sea to the southeast, and the Gulf of Mexico to the east.

description.en: North Macedonia, officially the Republic of North Macedonia, is a landlocked country in Southeastern Europe. It shares borders with Greece to the south, Albania to the west, Bulgaria to the east, Kosovo to the northwest and Serbia to the north.

description.en: Mali, officially the Republic of Mali, is a landlocked country in West Africa. It is the eighth-largest country in Africa and the 23rd largest country in the world, with an area of 1,240,192 square kilometres .
description.zh-CN: 马里共和国，通稱馬里，是位於西非萨赫勒地区的内陆国家，北部地區北接阿尔及利亚、东接尼日尔、西面毛里塔尼亚，南部西接塞内加尔、西南接几内亚、南鄰布基纳法索和科特迪瓦，是西非面积第二大的国家。其北面國界深入撒哈拉沙漠腹地，人口主要集中在南部，尼日尔河和塞内加尔河皆源于此。
description.zh-TW: 馬裏共和國，通稱馬裏，是位於西非薩赫勒地區的內陸國家，北部地區北接阿爾及利亞、東接尼日爾、西面毛里塔尼亞，南部西接塞內加爾、西南接幾內亞、南鄰布基納法索和科特迪瓦，是西非面積第二大的國家。其北面國界深入撒哈拉沙漠腹地，人口主要集中在南部，尼日爾河和塞內加爾河皆源於此。

description.zh-TW: 馬裏共和國，通稱馬裏，是位於西非薩赫勒地區的內陸國家，北部地區北接阿爾及利亞、東接尼日爾、西面毛里塔尼亞，南部西接塞內加爾、西南接幾內亞、南鄰布基納法索和科特迪瓦，是西非面積第二大的國家。其北面國界深入撒哈拉沙漠腹地，人口主要集中在南部，尼日爾河和塞內加爾河皆源於此。

description.en: Malta, officially the Republic of Malta, is an island country located in the central Mediterranean Sea. It consists of a number of islands, of which Malta and Gozo are the two main ones—south of Italy, east of Tunisia, and north of Libya.

description.en: Montenegro is a country in Southeastern Europe, on the Balkan Peninsula. Its 25 municipalities have a total population of 633,158 people in an area of 13,883 km2 .
description.zh-CN: 黑山是一個位於歐洲巴尔干半岛西南部、亞得里亞海東岸上的多山國家。黑山的東北為塞爾維亞，東為科索沃，東南為阿爾巴尼亞，西北為波士尼亞與赫塞哥維納以及克羅埃西亞，西南則為亞得里亞海。

description.en: Mauritania, officially the Islamic Republic of Mauritania, is a country in the Maghreb region of West Africa. It is bordered by the Atlantic Ocean to the west, Western Sahara to the north and northwest, Algeria to the northeast, Mali to the east and southeast, and Senegal to the southwest.
description.zh-CN: 毛里塔尼亚伊斯兰共和国，通稱毛里塔尼亞，是位於西非的國家，也是非洲的马格里布阿拉伯国家之一。与阿尔及利亚、馬利、塞内加尔和西撒哈拉争议地区接壤。
description.zh-TW: 毛里塔尼亞伊斯蘭共和國，通稱毛裏塔尼亞，是位於西非的國家，也是非洲的馬格里布阿拉伯國家之一。與阿爾及利亞、馬利、塞內加爾和西撒哈拉爭議地區接壤。

photo.alt: "Gen. Mohamed Ould Abdel Aziz in his home city Akjoujt, Mauritania, 15 Mar 2009" Note that the man at right is in the distinctive grey uniform of an officer of the Mauritanian Armed Forces. "General Mohamed Ould Abdel Aziz said Saturday the military would proceed with the plan for presidential elections on June 6, saying the polls would be free and fair, and open to all. Speaking at a rally in his native city of Akjoujt , General Aziz said Mauritanians have the duty to register and to vote for the candidate they feel will best lead the country forward."

description.en: The Netherlands, also informally known as Holland, is a country in Northwestern Europe, with overseas territories in the Caribbean. It is the largest of the four constituent countries of the Kingdom of the Netherlands.
description.zh-CN: 尼德蘭，中文通稱荷蘭，是位于欧洲西部的低地国家，由歐洲區荷蘭的12個省份和荷蘭加勒比區的博奈爾島、聖尤斯特歇斯島和薩巴島組成。荷蘭也是荷蘭王國的四个構成國之一，与美洲加勒比地区的阿鲁巴、库拉索和荷屬聖馬丁共同组成荷蘭王國。

description.en: Norway, officially the Kingdom of Norway, is a Nordic country comprising the western and northernmost parts of the Scandinavian Peninsula in Northern Europe, the remote Arctic island Jan Mayen and the archipelago of Svalbard. Bouvet Island, located in the Subantarctic, is a dependency, and not a part of the Kingdom; Norway also claims the Antarctic territories of Peter I Island and Queen Maud Land.
description.zh-CN: 挪威，全称挪威王国，是一个位于斯堪的纳维亚半岛的北欧国家。挪威本土位于欧洲大陆西北部，涵盖北极地区的扬马延岛和斯瓦尔巴群岛，此外还在南大西洋还拥有布韦岛。
description.zh-TW: 挪威，全稱挪威王國，是一個位於斯堪的納維亞半島的北歐國家。挪威本土位於歐洲大陸西北部，涵蓋北極地區的揚馬延島和斯瓦爾巴羣島，此外還在南大西洋還擁有布韋島。

description.en: Poland, officially the Republic of Poland, is a country in Central Europe. description.en: Portugal, officially the Portuguese Republic, is a country in Southwestern Europe. Mainland Portugal is located on the southwestern portion of the Iberian Peninsula, and bordered by Spain to the north and east.
description.zh-CN: 葡萄牙共和國，簡稱葡萄牙或葡國，是位於西南歐伊比利亞半島上的一個共和制國家，實行單一制和半總統制政體，以里斯本為首都。葡萄牙的西部及南部瀕臨大西洋，北部及東部則與西班牙相接，本土總面積達92,212平方公里，而地處里斯本以西的羅卡角則為歐洲大陸的最西端。

description.en: Palestine, officially the State of Palestine, is a country in the Southern Levant region of West Asia. Situated between the Mediterranean Sea and Jordan River, it comprises the territories of the West Bank and the Gaza Strip, both of which are under occupation by Israel.
description.zh-CN: 巴勒斯坦國，通稱巴勒斯坦，是位于西亚巴勒斯坦地区的有限承認國家。1988年11月15日，巴勒斯坦民族委员会通过獨立宣言并由巴勒斯坦解放組織在阿尔及利亚宣读。
description.zh-TW: 巴勒斯坦國，通稱巴勒斯坦，是位於西亞巴勒斯坦地區的有限承認國家。1988年11月15日，巴勒斯坦民族委員會通過獨立宣言並由巴勒斯坦解放組織在阿爾及利亞宣讀。

photo.alt: Dome of the Rock (Arabic: مسجد قبة الصخرة‎, Hebrew: כיפת הסלע), (NE facade, panel detail with ceramic tiles on the Temple Mount in the Old City of Jerusalem. The tiles were added as part of the redecoration of the building ordered by Sultan Suleyman who sent a group of tile-makers from Istanbul to Jerusalem. They were led by Abdullah Tabrizi who signed the cut-tile inscription at the top of the drum with the date 952 AH/AD 1545-6 and the inscription above the north porch with the date 959 AH/AD 1551-2. The tile-makers used a range of techniques, including cut-tile work, cuerda seca, and under-glaze. See: Atasoy, Nurhan; Raby, Julian (1989), Iznik: The Pottery of Ottoman Turkey, London: Alexandra Press, ISBN 978-1-85669-054-6, p. 220.Two versions exist of this image: Regular (Non pseudo-HDR) and a pseudo-HDR.
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Serbia, officially the Republic of Serbia, is a landlocked country in Southeastern and Central Europe. It is bordered by Hungary to the north, Romania to the northeast, Bulgaria to the southeast, North Macedonia to the south, Croatia to the northwest, Bosnia and Herzegovina to the west, Montenegro to the southwest, and it also claims a border with Albania through the disputed territory of Kosovo.
description.zh-CN: 塞尔维亚共和国，简称塞尔维亚，是一個巴爾幹半島內陸國，位於歐洲東南部和中部、巴爾幹半島中部、潘諾尼亞平原之上，系屬中東歐或東歐國家。北邻匈牙利，东北有羅馬尼亞，东南有保加利亞，南与北馬其頓接壤，西南有黑山，西边的邻国则是波士尼亞與赫塞哥維納、克羅地亞。
description.zh-TW: 塞爾維亞共和國，簡稱塞爾維亞，是一個巴爾幹半島內陸國，位於歐洲東南部和中部、巴爾幹半島中部、潘諾尼亞平原之上，系屬中東歐或東歐國家。北鄰匈牙利，東北有羅馬尼亞，東南有保加利亞，南與北馬其頓接壤，西南有黑山，西邊的鄰國則是波士尼亞與赫塞哥維納、克羅地亞。

description.en: Sweden, formally the Kingdom of Sweden, is a Nordic country located on the Scandinavian Peninsula in Northern Europe. It borders Norway to the west and north, Finland to the east, and shares a maritime border with Denmark to the south.
description.zh-CN: 瑞典王國，通稱瑞典，是一个位于斯堪的纳维亚半岛的北歐国家，首都及最大城市为斯德哥尔摩。瑞典西鄰挪威，东北与芬兰接壤，西南濒临斯卡格拉克海峡和卡特加特海峡，東邊為波罗的海與波的尼亞灣，與丹麦、德国、波兰、俄罗斯、立陶宛、拉脫維亞和爱沙尼亚隔海相望，國土西南端通过厄勒海峽大桥与丹麦相连。
description.zh-TW: 瑞典王國，通稱瑞典，是一個位於斯堪的納維亞半島的北歐國家，首都及最大城市爲斯德哥爾摩。瑞典西鄰挪威，東北與芬蘭接壤，西南瀕臨斯卡格拉克海峽和卡特加特海峽，東邊為波羅的海與波的尼亞灣，與丹麥、德國、波蘭、俄羅斯、立陶宛、拉脫維亞和愛沙尼亞隔海相望，國土西南端通過厄勒海峽大橋與丹麥相連。

description.en: Sweden, formally the Kingdom of Sweden, is a Nordic country located on the Scandinavian Peninsula in Northern Europe. It borders Norway to the west and north, Finland to the east, and shares a maritime border with Denmark to the south.

description.en: The United States of America , also known as the United States or America, is a country primarily located in North America. It is a federal republic consisting of 50 states and a federal capital district, Washington, D.C. The 48 contiguous states border Canada to the north and Mexico to the south, with the semi-exclave of Alaska in the northwest and the archipelago of Hawaii in the Pacific Ocean.

description.zh-CN: 蒙大拿州是美國西北部的一州，州名來自於西班牙語的「montaña」，此州的面積381,156平方公里，在美國名列第四大，相當於日本國土面積大約100.5%，然而相對之下，人口相當稀少，據2025年估計僅1,144,694人，人口密度也相當低，經濟上以農牧為主，作物主要有燕麥、大麥和甜菜，亦有重要的採礦和伐木業。 此州的西邊有三分之一都是山脈，在東邊則有三分之二還屬於美國大平原的範圍。

photo.credit: Bureau of Land Management · Public domain
photo.alt: Our July #conservationlands15 Bucket List Location: Take a step back in time and paddle through history along the BLM Upper Missouri Wild and Scenic River in Montana “The hills and river Clifts which we passed today exhibit a most romantic appearance…. The bluffs of the river rise to hight of from 2 to 300 feet and in most places nearly perpendicular; they are formed of remarkable white sandstone which is sufficiently soft to give way readily to the impression of water…” Meriwether Lewis, May 31, 1805. You can camp in the same locations as the 1805 Lewis and Clark expedition on your multi-day canoe expedition down the “Big Muddy”. The river is a relatively easy paddle with current and riffles but no major rapids. Along the way, camp under the shade of spreading cottonwoods and try your luck catching a paddlefish – some weigh over 100 pounds. The Breaks Country surrounding the river offers opportunities for scrambles and cross country hikes to the bluffs above. The unique geology and harsh landscapes that were extensively described by Lewis and Clark are in a condition that has changed little since the passage of the expedition. Historic homesteads dot the river banks, and remnants of the steamboat era remain in inscriptions that were etched on the rock walls. Photo by Bob Wick, BLM

description.en: Ohio is a state in the Midwestern region of the United States. It borders the Canadian province of Ontario to the north , Pennsylvania to the east, West Virginia to the southeast, Kentucky to the southwest, Indiana to the west, and Michigan to the northwest.

description.zh-TW: 俄亥俄州，位於美國中西部，是五大湖地區的組成部分。俄亥俄州處於美國文化和地理的交叉口，州民來自新英格蘭、美國中部、阿巴拉契亞和美國上南部等地區。

description.en: Pennsylvania, officially the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, is a state located in the Mid-Atlantic, Northeastern, Appalachian, and Great Lakes regions of the United States. The state borders Delaware to its southeast, Maryland to its south, forming the Mason–Dixon line, West Virginia to its southwest, Ohio to its west, the Canadian province of Ontario to its northwest via Lake Erie, New York to its north, and the Delaware River and New Jersey to its east.
description.zh-CN: 宾夕法尼亚州是美國的州份之一，俗称“拱心石州”，或稱宾夕凡尼亚州，中文簡稱賓州。這個州的名稱起源于英国移民威廉·賓，英國國王查理二世為償還欠其父親的薪资而授予大片林地，拉丁文中的意思是“賓的林地”。
description.zh-TW: 賓夕法尼亞州是美國的州份之一，俗稱“拱心石州”，或稱賓夕凡尼亞州，中文簡稱賓州。這個州的名稱起源於英國移民威廉·賓，英國國王查理二世為償還欠其父親的薪資而授予大片林地，拉丁文中的意思是“賓的林地”。

description.en: New York, also called New York State, is a state located in the Northeastern United States. Bordering New England to its east, Pennsylvania and New Jersey to the south, and Canada to its north, New York extends into both the Atlantic Ocean and the Great Lakes.
description.zh-CN: 纽约州，別稱帝國州，是位於美国东北部的一个州，首府為奧爾巴尼，最大城市纽约市。纽约州西部及北部与加拿大魁北克省和安大略省接壤，东邻马萨诸塞州、康涅狄格州、佛蒙特州和大西洋，南接宾夕法尼亚州、新泽西州，西北部連接五大湖之一的安大略湖。
description.zh-TW: 紐約州，別稱帝國州，是位於美國東北部的一個州，首府為奧爾巴尼，最大城市紐約市。紐約州西部及北部與加拿大魁北克省和安大略省接壤，東鄰馬薩諸塞州、康涅狄格州、佛蒙特州和大西洋，南接賓夕法尼亞州、新澤西州，西北部連接五大湖之一的安大略湖。

description.en: Vermont is a landlocked state in the New England region of the Northeastern United States. It borders Massachusetts to the south, New Hampshire to the east, New York to the west, and the Canadian province of Quebec to the north.
description.zh-CN: 佛蒙特州是美国第14个州，境內出產奶制品以及枫糖浆。 佛蒙特總共擁有14個郡，轄下有255個政治單位或地區，其中有237個為城鎮、9個為城市、5個為非建制區域。
description.zh-TW: 佛蒙特州是美國第14個州，境內出產奶製品以及楓糖漿。 佛蒙特總共擁有14個郡，轄下有255個政治單位或地區，其中有237個為城鎮、9個為城市、5個為非建制區域。

description.en: New Hampshire is a state in the New England region of the Northeastern United States. It borders Massachusetts to the south, Vermont to the west, Maine and the Gulf of Maine to the east, and the Canadian province of Quebec to the north.
description.zh-CN: 新罕布什尔州，是位于美国东北部新英格兰地区的一个州，南接马萨诸塞州，西接佛蒙特州，东接缅因州及大西洋，北接加拿大魁北克省。州土地面积排名倒数第五，在五十个州中人口数量排名倒数第十。
description.zh-TW: 新罕布什爾州，是位於美國東北部新英格蘭地區的一個州，南接馬薩諸塞州，西接佛蒙特州，東接緬因州及大西洋，北接加拿大魁北克省。州土地面積排名倒數第五，在五十個州中人口數量排名倒數第十。

description.en: Maine is a state in the New England region of the United States, and the northeasternmost state in the contiguous United States. It borders New Hampshire to the west, the Gulf of Maine to the southeast, and the Canadian provinces of New Brunswick and Quebec to the northeast and northwest, and shares a maritime border with Nova Scotia.
description.zh-CN: 缅因州是美國東北部新英格蘭的一个州，北鄰加拿大魁北克省，東鄰加拿大新不倫瑞克省以及大西洋，西靠美國新罕布什爾州。

description.en: Arizona is a landlocked state in the Southwestern United States, sharing the Four Corners region with Colorado, New Mexico, and Utah. It also borders Nevada to the northwest and California to the west, and shares an international border with the Mexican states of Sonora and Baja California to the south and southwest.
description.zh-CN: 亞利桑那州是美國一個位於西南部的州份，同時也是西部和山區州份之一。此州是美國面積第6大及人口第14大的州份。
description.zh-TW: 亞利桑那州是美國一個位於西南部的州份，同時也是西部和山區州份之一。此州是美國面積第6大及人口第14大的州份。

photo.alt: The origin of this classic, simple meteorite impact crater was long the subject of controversy. The discovery of fragments of the Canyon Diablo meteorite, including fragments within the breccia deposits that partially fill the structure, and the presence of a range of shock-metamorphic features in the target sandstone, confirmed its impact origin. Target rocks include Paleozoic carbonates and sandstones; these rocks have been overturned just outside the rim during ejection. The hummocky deposits just beyond the rim are remnants of the ejecta blanket. This aerial view shows the dramatic expression of the crater in the arid landscape.

description.en: California is a state in the Western United States. It is bordered by Oregon to the north, the Mexican state of Baja California to the south, Nevada to the east, Arizona to the southeast, and the Pacific Ocean to the west.
description.zh-CN: 加利福尼亚州，簡稱加州，是美国西部太平洋沿岸的一个州。面積列美國第三；人口為3,918萬，列美國各州第一。
description.zh-TW: 加利福尼亞州，簡稱加州，是美國西部太平洋沿岸的一個州。面積列美國第三；人口為3,918萬，列美國各州第一。

description.en: New Mexico is a landlocked state in the Southwestern region of the United States. It is one of the Mountain States of the southern Rocky Mountains, sharing the Four Corners region with Utah, Colorado, and Arizona.
description.zh-CN: 新墨西哥州，簡稱新墨州，是美國西南方的一州，它曾是墨西哥的一省。德克薩斯共和國獨立後曾被該國宣稱主權，不過後來都變成美國的一部分，加入聯邦後經歷內戰，再度被美國併吞，二十世紀成為一州，該州仍有許多西班牙裔的居民，亦有不少的美國原住民。
description.zh-TW: 新墨西哥州，簡稱新墨州，是美國西南方的一州，它曾是墨西哥的一省。德克薩斯共和國獨立後曾被該國宣稱主權，不過後來都變成美國的一部分，加入聯邦後經歷內戰，再度被美國併吞，二十世紀成為一州，該州仍有許多西班牙裔的居民，亦有不少的美國原住民。

description.en: Texas is a state in the United States. Located in the south-central part of the country, it borders Louisiana, Arkansas, Oklahoma, and New Mexico.
description.zh-CN: 得克萨斯州，简称德州，旧译德沙士；是全美國土地面積和人口第二大的州。德克薩斯州位于美国中南部地区，东部与路易斯安那州，东北部与阿肯色州，北部与俄克拉荷马州，西部与新墨西哥州接壤，同时与墨西哥的奇瓦瓦州、科阿韋拉州、新莱昂州、塔毛利帕斯州共享边界，在东南部还有一段墨西哥湾海岸线。
description.zh-TW: 得克薩斯州，簡稱德州，舊譯德沙士；是全美國土地面積和人口第二大的州。德克薩斯州位於美國中南部地區，東部與路易斯安那州，東北部與阿肯色州，北部與俄克拉荷馬州，西部與新墨西哥州接壤，同時與墨西哥的奇瓦瓦州、科阿韋拉州、新萊昂州、塔毛利帕斯州共享邊界，在東南部還有一段墨西哥灣海岸線。

description.en: Louisiana is a state in the Deep South and South Central regions of the United States. It is bordered by Texas to the west, Arkansas to the north, and Mississippi to the east.

description.en: Mississippi is a state in the Southeastern and Deep South regions of the United States. It borders Tennessee to the north, Alabama to the east, the Gulf of Mexico to the south, Louisiana to the southwest, and Arkansas to the northwest.

description.en: Alabama is a state in the Southeastern and Deep Southern regions of the United States. It borders Tennessee to the north, Georgia to the east, Florida and the Gulf of Mexico to the south, and Mississippi to the west.
description.zh-CN: 阿拉巴马州，也译作阿拉巴马州，是美國東南部地區一個聯邦州。北接田納西州，東鄰喬治亞州，南至佛羅里達州和墨西哥灣，西臨密西西比州。

description.en: Florida is a state in the Southeastern and South Atlantic regions of the United States. It borders the Gulf of Mexico to the west, Alabama to the northwest, Georgia to the north, the Atlantic Ocean to the east, the Straits of Florida to the south, and The Bahamas to the southeast.

description.en: South Carolina is a state in the Southeastern, South Atlantic and Deep South regions of the United States. It borders North Carolina to the north and northeast, the Atlantic Ocean to the southeast, and Georgia to the west and south across the Savannah River.

description.en: North Carolina is a state in the Southeastern and South Atlantic regions of the United States. It is bordered by Virginia to the north, the Atlantic Ocean to the east, South Carolina to the south, Georgia to the southwest, and Tennessee to the west.

description.en: Virginia, officially the Commonwealth of Virginia, is a state in the Southeastern and Mid-Atlantic regions of the United States between the Atlantic Coast and the Appalachian Mountains. It borders Kentucky to the west, Tennessee to the south-west, North Carolina to the south, West Virginia to the north-west, and Maryland to the north.
description.zh-CN: 維珍尼亞州是美国东部的一个州，美国开国十三州之一。 維吉尼亚州疆域范围位于北纬36°31'至39°37'，西经75°13'至83°37'之间，其北部地区与美国政治中心华盛顿哥伦比亚特区相邻；东南部的诺福克市则有全世界最大的军港和海军基地。

description.en: Washington is a state in the Pacific Northwest region of the United States. It is commonly referred to as Washington state to distinguish it from the national capital; both are named after George Washington, a U.S. Founding Father and the first U.S. president.
description.zh-CN: 华盛顿州，简称华州，是一個位於美国西北太平洋沿岸的州。北接加拿大不列顛哥倫比亞省，南接俄勒岡州，東臨愛達荷州，西鄰太平洋。
description.zh-TW: 華盛頓州，簡稱華州，是一個位於美國西北太平洋沿岸的州。北接加拿大不列顛哥倫比亞省，南接俄勒岡州，東臨愛達荷州，西鄰太平洋。

description.en: Maryland is a state in the Mid-Atlantic and Southeastern regions of the United States. It borders Virginia to its south, West Virginia to its west, Pennsylvania to its north, and Delaware to its east, as well as with the Atlantic Ocean to its east, and the national capital and federal district of Washington, D.C. to the southwest.
description.zh-CN: 马里兰州，简称马州，是美国的一州，屬於美國中大西洋地區，其西邊與南邊與西維吉尼亞州、維吉尼亞州、華盛頓哥倫比亞特區接壤，北方是賓夕法尼亞州，東鄰為德拉瓦州。馬里蘭州是第七個通過美國憲法的州，有三個常見的暱稱：老戰線州、自由之州、切薩皮克灣州。

description.en: Arkansas is a landlocked state in the West South Central region of the Southern United States. It borders Missouri to the north, Tennessee and Mississippi to the east, Louisiana to the south, Texas to the southwest, and Oklahoma to the west.
description.zh-CN: 阿肯色州，是美国南部的一个州份，位處密西西比河中下游，北接密苏里州，西界俄克拉荷马州，南邻路易斯安那州，西南与得克萨斯州接壤，东隔密西西比河与田纳西州和密西西比州相望。其面积137,539平方公里，在五十個州內列第29位。
description.zh-TW: 阿肯色州，是美國南部的一個州份，位處密西西比河中下游，北接密蘇里州，西界俄克拉荷馬州，南鄰路易斯安那州，西南與得克薩斯州接壤，東隔密西西比河與田納西州和密西西比州相望。其面積137,539平方公里，在五十個州內列第29位。

description.en: Tennessee , officially the State of Tennessee, is a landlocked state in the Southeastern region of the United States. It borders Kentucky to the north, Virginia to the northeast, North Carolina to the east, Georgia, Alabama, and Mississippi to the south, Arkansas to the southwest, and Missouri to the northwest.
description.zh-CN: 田纳西州，位于美国南方，首府及最大城市為納許維爾，是美國音樂聖地，也是美国乡村音乐的中心。其他著名城市还有孟菲斯、诺克斯维尔和查塔努加。
description.zh-TW: 田納西州，位於美國南方，首府及最大城市為納許維爾，是美國音樂聖地，也是美國鄉村音樂的中心。其他著名城市還有孟菲斯、諾克斯維爾和查塔努加。

description.en: West Virginia is a mountainous, landlocked state in the Southern and Mid-Atlantic regions of the United States. It is bordered by Pennsylvania and Maryland to the northeast, Virginia to the southeast, Kentucky to the southwest, and Ohio to the northwest.
description.zh-CN: 西維珍尼亞州，簡稱西弗州，是美國東部的一個州，有著名的阿帕拉契山脈，別稱為「山脈之州」。 西維珍尼亞是在美國南北戰爭時期由當時的維吉尼亞州西北部的48郡因反對脫離美利堅合眾國所分裂出來的。
description.zh-TW: 西維珍尼亞州，簡稱西弗州，是美國東部的一個州，有著名的阿帕拉契山脈，別稱為「山脈之州」。 西維珍尼亞是在美國南北戰爭時期由當時的維吉尼亞州西北部的48郡因反對脫離美利堅合眾國所分裂出來的。

description.en: Indiana is a state in the Midwestern region of the United States. It borders Lake Michigan to the northwest, Michigan to the north and northeast, Ohio to the east, the Ohio River and Kentucky to the south and southeast, and the Wabash River and Illinois to the west.
description.zh-CN: 印第安纳州是美国中西部的一个州，首府及最大城市為印第安纳波利斯。印第安纳州是美国50个州中按面积第38大，按人口第17大的州。
description.zh-TW: 印第安納州是美國中西部的一個州，首府及最大城市為印第安納波利斯。印第安納州是美國50個州中按面積第38大，按人口第17大的州。

description.en: Cyprus, officially the Republic of Cyprus, is an island country in the eastern Mediterranean Sea, located off the coast of the Levant mainland in West Asia. The island of Cyprus, which is the third largest and third most populous island in the Mediterranean, is divided along the United Nations Buffer Zone between the internationally recognised Republic of Cyprus and the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, which is recognised only by Turkey.
description.zh-CN: 賽普勒斯共和國，通稱賽普勒斯，是位於歐亞大陸交匯處地中海東部的一個島國，面積9,251平方公里。 已知人類在賽普勒斯的活動足跡最早可以追溯至西元前一萬年，此一時期的遺址有喬伊魯科蒂亞，為新石器時代保存至今依然完好的建築群。
description.zh-TW: 賽普勒斯共和國，通稱賽普勒斯，是位於歐亞大陸交匯處地中海東部的一個島國，面積9,251平方公里。 已知人類在賽普勒斯的活動足跡最早可以追溯至西元前一萬年，此一時期的遺址有喬伊魯科蒂亞，為新石器時代保存至今依然完好的建築羣。

description.en: Israel, officially the State of Israel, is a country in the Southern Levant region of West Asia. It is bordered by Lebanon to the north, Syria to the northeast, Jordan to the east, and Egypt to the southwest.
description.zh-CN: 以色列国，通稱以色列，是一个位于西亚的国家。其北邻黎巴嫩，东北接叙利亚，东接约旦，西南与埃及接壤，西濒地中海。
description.zh-TW: 以色列國，通稱以色列，是一個位於西亞的國家。其北鄰黎巴嫩，東北接敘利亞，東接約旦，西南與埃及接壤，西瀕地中海。

photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Palestine, officially the State of Palestine, is a country in the Southern Levant region of West Asia. Situated between the Mediterranean Sea and Jordan River, it comprises the territories of the West Bank and the Gaza Strip, both of which are under occupation by Israel.
description.zh-CN: 巴勒斯坦國，通稱巴勒斯坦，是位于西亚巴勒斯坦地区的有限承認國家。1988年11月15日，巴勒斯坦民族委员会通过獨立宣言并由巴勒斯坦解放組織在阿尔及利亚宣读。
description.zh-TW: 巴勒斯坦國，通稱巴勒斯坦，是位於西亞巴勒斯坦地區的有限承認國家。1988年11月15日，巴勒斯坦民族委員會通過獨立宣言並由巴勒斯坦解放組織在阿爾及利亞宣讀。

photo.alt: Dome of the Rock (Arabic: مسجد قبة الصخرة‎, Hebrew: כיפת הסלע), (NE facade, panel detail with ceramic tiles on the Temple Mount in the Old City of Jerusalem. The tiles were added as part of the redecoration of the building ordered by Sultan Suleyman who sent a group of tile-makers from Istanbul to Jerusalem. They were led by Abdullah Tabrizi who signed the cut-tile inscription at the top of the drum with the date 952 AH/AD 1545-6 and the inscription above the north porch with the date 959 AH/AD 1551-2. The tile-makers used a range of techniques, including cut-tile work, cuerda seca, and under-glaze. See: Atasoy, Nurhan; Raby, Julian (1989), Iznik: The Pottery of Ottoman Turkey, London: Alexandra Press, ISBN 978-1-85669-054-6, p. 220.Two versions exist of this image: Regular (Non pseudo-HDR) and a pseudo-HDR.
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Lebanon, officially the Lebanese Republic, is a country in the Levant region of West Asia. Situated at the crossroads of the Mediterranean Basin and the Arabian Peninsula, it is bordered by Syria to the north and east, Israel to the south, and the Mediterranean Sea to the west; Cyprus lies a short distance from the coastline.
description.zh-CN: 黎巴嫩共和国，通稱黎巴嫩，位于亚洲西南部、地中海东岸，习惯上歸屬於中东国家。东北部与叙利亚接壤，南部与以色列为邻，西濒地中海。
description.zh-TW: 黎巴嫩共和國，通稱黎巴嫩，位於亞洲西南部、地中海東岸，習慣上歸屬於中東國家。東北部與敘利亞接壤，南部與以色列爲鄰，西瀕地中海。

description.en: Syria, officially the Syrian Arab Republic, is a country in West Asia located in the Eastern Mediterranean and the Levant. It borders the Mediterranean Sea to the west, Turkey to the north and northwest, Iraq to the east and southeast, Jordan to the south, and Israel and Lebanon to the southwest.
description.zh-CN: 敘利亞阿拉伯共和國，簡稱敘利亞，為一西亞國家，地處東地中海和黎凡特地區；北與土耳其接壤，东與伊拉克交界，南與约旦毗连，西南和黎巴嫩和以色列为邻，西濒地中海。敘利亞擁有約2,500萬人口，排名世界第57位；國土面積為185,180平方公里，排名世界第87位。
description.zh-TW: 敘利亞阿拉伯共和國，簡稱敘利亞，為一西亞國家，地處東地中海和黎凡特地區；北與土耳其接壤，東與伊拉克交界，南與約旦毗連，西南和黎巴嫩和以色列爲鄰，西瀕地中海。敘利亞擁有約2,500萬人口，排名世界第57位；國土面積為185,180平方公里，排名世界第87位。

description.en: Morocco, officially the Kingdom of Morocco, is a country in North Africa. It has coastlines on the Mediterranean Sea to the north and the Atlantic Ocean to the west, and has land borders with Algeria to the east; the Spanish exclaves of Ceuta, Melilla and Peñón de Vélez de la Gomera along the north, which it claims together with several small Spanish-controlled islands; and the disputed territory of Western Sahara to the south, partly occupied by Morocco since 1975.
description.zh-CN: 摩洛哥王国，通稱摩洛哥，是北非西端马格里布的一个君主立宪制国家。其东部与阿尔及利亚接壤，南部其实际管辖的西撒哈拉地区与毛里塔尼亚紧邻，西部滨临大西洋，并向北隔直布罗陀海峡和地中海与葡萄牙、西班牙相望。
description.zh-TW: 摩洛哥王國，通稱摩洛哥，是北非西端馬格里布的一個君主立憲制國家。其東部與阿爾及利亞接壤，南部其實際管轄的西撒哈拉地區與毛里塔尼亞緊鄰，西部濱臨大西洋，並向北隔直布羅陀海峽和地中海與葡萄牙、西班牙相望。

description.en: Western Sahara is a United Nations–designated non-self-governing territory in north-western Africa. It has a surface area of 272,000 square kilometres .
description.zh-CN: 西撒哈拉位於非洲西北部、撒哈拉沙漠西部，濱臨大西洋，與茅利塔尼亞、阿爾及利亞相鄰，是一個有爭議地區，主要居民為撒拉威人、柏柏爾人、阿拉伯人。 西撒哈拉于1886年起屬西班牙。
description.zh-TW: 西撒哈拉位於非洲西北部、撒哈拉沙漠西部，濱臨大西洋，與茅利塔尼亞、阿爾及利亞相鄰，是一個有爭議地區，主要居民為撒拉威人、柏柏爾人、阿拉伯人。 西撒哈拉於1886年起屬西班牙。

description.en: Ukraine is a country in Eastern Europe. It is the second-largest country in Europe after Russia, which borders it to the east and northeast.
description.zh-CN: 乌克兰是位於東歐的共和制國家，南接黑海，東連俄羅斯，北與白羅斯毗邻，西與波蘭、斯洛伐克、匈牙利、羅馬尼亞和摩尔多瓦諸國相連。全國劃分為24個州，1個自治共和國，2個特殊地位城市。
description.zh-TW: 烏克蘭是位於東歐的共和制國家，南接黑海，東連俄羅斯，北與白羅斯毗鄰，西與波蘭、斯洛伐克、匈牙利、羅馬尼亞和摩爾多瓦諸國相連。全國劃分為24個州，1個自治共和國，2個特殊地位城市。

description.en: Belarus, officially the Republic of Belarus, is a landlocked country in Eastern Europe. It is bordered by Russia to the east and northeast, Ukraine to the south, Poland to the west, and Lithuania and Latvia to the northwest.
description.zh-CN: 白俄羅斯共和國，其政府官方中文國號全名稱為白罗斯共和國，简称白俄罗斯、白俄或白羅斯，是位于东欧的内陆国家，首都為明斯克。白俄罗斯东及北部与俄罗斯为邻，南部与乌克兰接壤，西部同波兰、立陶宛和拉脱维亚毗邻，国土面积207,600平方公里，2021年人口934万人，大部分居住在明斯克或者其他大城市附近。
description.zh-TW: 白俄羅斯共和國，其政府官方中文國號全名稱為白羅斯共和國，簡稱白俄羅斯、白俄或白羅斯，是位於東歐的內陸國家，首都為明斯克。白俄羅斯東及北部與俄羅斯爲鄰，南部與烏克蘭接壤，西部同波蘭、立陶宛和拉脫維亞毗鄰，國土面積207,600平方公里，2021年人口934萬人，大部分居住在明斯克或者其他大城市附近。

photo.alt: Panoramic view of Strusta Lake, Braslau Lakes, Belarus (2010)
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Lithuania, officially the Republic of Lithuania, is a country in the Baltic region of Europe. It is one of three Baltic states and lies on the eastern shore of the Baltic Sea, bordered by Latvia to the north, Belarus to the east and south, Poland to the south, and the Russian semi-exclave of Kaliningrad Oblast to the southwest, with a maritime border with Sweden to the west.
description.zh-CN: 立陶宛共和國，通稱立陶宛，位于欧洲东北部，是波罗的海三国之一，根據地理分區的不同定義，立陶宛被認為處在北歐和中東歐。首都與最大城市為维尔纽斯，另外還有考那斯與克萊佩達等城市。
description.zh-TW: 立陶宛共和國，通稱立陶宛，位於歐洲東北部，是波羅的海三國之一，根據地理分區的不同定義，立陶宛被認為處在北歐和中東歐。首都與最大城市為維爾紐斯，另外還有考那斯與克萊佩達等城市。

alt.zh-TW: 立陶宛周邊地表，2000年Landsat真彩衛星合成影像。

description.en: Russia, or the Russian Federation, is a country in Eastern Europe and North Asia. It is the largest country in the world, spanning eleven time zones and sharing land borders with fourteen countries.
description.zh-CN: 俄罗斯联邦，通称俄國或俄羅斯，是位於欧亚大陆北部的聯邦共和國。其國土横跨欧亞两大洲，为目前世界上领土最大的国家，面积达1710万平方公里，約占地球陆地面积的八分之一；俄罗斯是多民族国家，拥有1.46亿人口，人数排名世界第九，其中77%居住于其较为发达的欧洲部分。
description.zh-TW: 俄羅斯聯邦，通稱俄國或俄羅斯，是位於歐亞大陸北部的聯邦共和國。其國土橫跨歐亞兩大洲，爲目前世界上領土最大的國家，面積達1710萬平方公里，約佔地球陸地面積的八分之一；俄羅斯是多民族國家，擁有1.46億人口，人數排名世界第九，其中77%居住於其較爲發達的歐洲部分。

photo.alt: Frozen lake Baikal near Olkhon island.
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: The Czech Republic, also known as Czechia and historically known as Bohemia, is a landlocked country in Central Europe. The country is bordered by Austria to the south, Germany to the west, Poland to the northeast, and Slovakia to the southeast.
description.zh-CN: 捷克共和國，通稱捷克，史称波希米亚，是一个位于中欧的内陆国家，南邻奥地利，西邻德国，北邻波兰，东邻斯洛伐克。国土面积7.89万平方公里，丘陵起伏，多为温带大陆性气候和海洋性气候。
description.zh-TW: 捷克共和國，通稱捷克，史稱波希米亞，是一個位於中歐的內陸國家，南鄰奧地利，西鄰德國，北鄰波蘭，東鄰斯洛伐克。國土面積7.89萬平方公里，丘陵起伏，多爲溫帶大陸性氣候和海洋性氣候。

photo.alt: Krkonoše mountains in winter 2018
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Saxony, officially the Free State of Saxony, is a landlocked state of Germany, bordering the states of Brandenburg, Saxony-Anhalt, Thuringia, and Bavaria, as well as the countries of the Czechia and Poland. Its capital is Dresden, and its largest city is Leipzig.
description.zh-CN: 萨克森自由州，通称萨克森州，是德意志联邦共和国的一个联邦州，位于德国东部。是于1990年兩德統一后新成立的。
description.zh-TW: 薩克森自由州，通稱薩克森州，是德意志聯邦共和國的一個聯邦州，位於德國東部。是於1990年兩德統一後新成立的。

photo.alt: View from the Friedensbrücke to the town Bautzen in Saxony, Germany. In the foreground the so-called Hexenhäuschen (before 1604). In the centre the Mönchsbastei (1324) on Mühltorgasse. In the background (from left) the water tower (1877) in the ruins of the monk's church, the Dom St. Petri (1213/1221) and the Town Hall Bautzen (1213/1705).
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Bavaria, officially the Free State of Bavaria, is a landlocked state of Germany. It borders the states of Baden-Württemberg to the west, Hesse to the north-west, and Thuringia and Saxony to the north, as well as the countries of Switzerland and Austria to the south and the Czech Republic to the east.
description.zh-CN: 巴伐利亞自由州，简称巴伐利亚州，通稱巴伐利亞，也译作拜仁州、拜恩州，是德意志联邦共和国东南部的一个联邦州，首府位於慕尼黑，其西北部与巴登-符腾堡、图林根、萨克森、黑森诸州接壤，东部与捷克，南部与奥地利接壤。 巴伐利亞的面積可以佔到德国的1/5，是德國面積最大的州，也是人口和經濟第二高的州，僅次于北萊茵-西法倫，佔據德国GDP的18%。
description.zh-TW: 巴伐利亞自由州，簡稱巴伐利亞州，通稱巴伐利亞，也譯作拜仁州、拜恩州，是德意志聯邦共和國東南部的一個聯邦州，首府位於慕尼黑，其西北部與巴登-符騰堡、圖林根、薩克森、黑森諸州接壤，東部與捷克，南部與奧地利接壤。 巴伐利亞的面積可以佔到德國的1/5，是德國面積最大的州，也是人口和經濟第二高的州，僅次於北萊茵-西法倫，佔據德國GDP的18%。

photo.alt: Aerial Photography of the Adidas Headquarters in Herzogenaurach, Germany
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Estonia, officially the Republic of Estonia, is a country in the Baltic region of Northern Europe. It is bordered to the north by the Gulf of Finland across from Finland, to the west by the Baltic Sea across from Sweden, to the south by Latvia, and to the east by Russia.
description.zh-CN: 爱沙尼亚，正式名称为爱沙尼亚共和国，是一个位于北欧或中东欧的国家。其北临芬兰湾，与芬兰隔海相望；西濒波罗的海与瑞典相对；南接拉脱维亚；东邻俄罗斯。
description.zh-TW: 愛沙尼亞，正式名稱爲愛沙尼亞共和國，是一個位於北歐或中東歐的國家。其北臨芬蘭灣，與芬蘭隔海相望；西瀕波羅的海與瑞典相對；南接拉脫維亞；東鄰俄羅斯。

photo.alt: Rõuste wind farm, Hanila Parish, Lääne County, Estonia
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Latvia, officially the Republic of Latvia, is a country in the Baltic region of northern Europe. It is one of the three Baltic states, along with Estonia to the north and Lithuania to the south.
description.zh-CN: 拉脫維亞共和國，通稱拉脫維亞，是位于波罗的海东岸的欧洲东北部国家，是波羅的海國家之一。根據地理分區的不同定義，拉脫維亞被認為處在北歐和中東歐。
description.zh-TW: 拉脫維亞共和國，通稱拉脫維亞，是位於波羅的海東岸的歐洲東北部國家，是波羅的海國家之一。根據地理分區的不同定義，拉脫維亞被認為處在北歐和中東歐。

photo.alt: A 360 degree panoramic view of the skyline of Riga in Latvia.
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Norway, officially the Kingdom of Norway, is a Nordic country comprising the western and northernmost parts of the Scandinavian Peninsula in Northern Europe, the remote Arctic island Jan Mayen and the archipelago of Svalbard. Bouvet Island, located in the Subantarctic, is a dependency, and not a part of the Kingdom; Norway also claims the Antarctic territories of Peter I Island and Queen Maud Land.
description.zh-CN: 挪威，全称挪威王国，是一个位于斯堪的纳维亚半岛的北欧国家。挪威本土位于欧洲大陆西北部，涵盖北极地区的扬马延岛和斯瓦尔巴群岛，此外还在南大西洋还拥有布韦岛。
description.zh-TW: 挪威，全稱挪威王國，是一個位於斯堪的納維亞半島的北歐國家。挪威本土位於歐洲大陸西北部，涵蓋北極地區的揚馬延島和斯瓦爾巴羣島，此外還在南大西洋還擁有布韋島。

photo.credit: Avinor Oslo lufthavn/Espen Solli · CC BY 3.0
photo.alt: View of Oslo Airport at dusk
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Sweden, formally the Kingdom of Sweden, is a Nordic country located on the Scandinavian Peninsula in Northern Europe. It borders Norway to the west and north, Finland to the east, and shares a maritime border with Denmark to the south.
description.zh-CN: 瑞典王國，通稱瑞典，是一个位于斯堪的纳维亚半岛的北歐国家，首都及最大城市为斯德哥尔摩。瑞典西鄰挪威，东北与芬兰接壤，西南濒临斯卡格拉克海峡和卡特加特海峡，東邊為波罗的海與波的尼亞灣，與丹麦、德国、波兰、俄罗斯、立陶宛、拉脫維亞和爱沙尼亚隔海相望，國土西南端通过厄勒海峽大桥与丹麦相连。
description.zh-TW: 瑞典王國，通稱瑞典，是一個位於斯堪的納維亞半島的北歐國家，首都及最大城市爲斯德哥爾摩。瑞典西鄰挪威，東北與芬蘭接壤，西南瀕臨斯卡格拉克海峽和卡特加特海峽，東邊為波羅的海與波的尼亞灣，與丹麥、德國、波蘭、俄羅斯、立陶宛、拉脫維亞和愛沙尼亞隔海相望，國土西南端通過厄勒海峽大橋與丹麥相連。

photo.alt: H&M Canal City Hakata shop in Canal City Hakata East Building at Fukuoka,Japan.
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Finland, officially the Republic of Finland, is a Nordic country in Northern Europe. It borders Sweden to the northwest, Norway to the north, and Russia to the east, with the Gulf of Bothnia to the west and the Gulf of Finland to the south, opposite Estonia.
description.zh-CN: 芬兰，全称芬兰共和国，是位于北欧的沿海国家。其西北与瑞典北博滕省接壤，北接挪威特罗姆斯郡和芬马克郡，东部分别与俄罗斯的摩尔曼斯克州、卡累利阿共和国和列宁格勒州相邻；西濒波的尼亚湾，南临芬兰湾，与爱沙尼亚隔海相望。
description.zh-TW: 芬蘭，全稱芬蘭共和國，是位於北歐的沿海國家。其西北與瑞典北博滕省接壤，北接挪威特羅姆斯郡和芬馬克郡，東部分別與俄羅斯的摩爾曼斯克州、卡累利阿共和國和列寧格勒州相鄰；西瀕波的尼亞灣，南臨芬蘭灣，與愛沙尼亞隔海相望。

photo.alt: View to Lake Pielinen from Paha-Koli in Lieksa, Finland in 2019 July.
photo.originalFile: View to Pielinen from Paha-Koli in Lieksa, Finland, 2019 July.jpg
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Rhineland-Palatinate is a landlocked state in western Germany. It covers 19,846 km2 and has about 4.05 million residents.
description.zh-CN: 莱茵兰-普法尔茨是德意志联邦共和国的一个州，位于德国西南部莱茵河中游．全境由19世紀的黑森大公國萊茵領地及巴伐利亞王國普法尔茨領地共同組成，首府美因茨。
description.zh-TW: 萊茵蘭-普法爾茨是德意志聯邦共和國的一個州，位於德國西南部萊茵河中游．全境由19世紀的黑森大公國萊茵領地及巴伐利亞王國普法爾茨領地共同組成，首府美因茨。

description.en: Luxembourg, officially the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, is a landlocked country in Western Europe. It is bordered by Belgium to the west and north, Germany to the east, and France to the south.
description.zh-CN: 卢森堡大公国，简称卢森堡，坐落于西欧腹地，是一座被比利时、德国与法国环绕的內陸國家。其首都卢森堡市作为欧盟四大法定办公地之一，集中行使着多项欧盟职能，尤其是作为歐洲聯盟法院的驻地，掌控着欧盟的最高司法权。
description.zh-TW: 盧森堡大公國，簡稱盧森堡，坐落於西歐腹地，是一座被比利時、德國與法國環繞的內陸國家。其首都盧森堡市作爲歐盟四大法定辦公地之一，集中行使着多項歐盟職能，尤其是作爲歐洲聯盟法院的駐地，掌控着歐盟的最高司法權。

photo.credit: NASA / USGS · Landsat WELD · 2000 · Public domain

description.en: Saarland is a landlocked federal state of Germany in the southwest of the country. With an area of 2,570 km2 and a population of 1 million in 2024, it is the smallest German state in area apart from the city-states of Berlin, Bremen, and Hamburg, and the smallest in population apart from Bremen.
description.zh-CN: 薩爾蘭，原名薩爾，是德国西南部的一个联邦州，首府萨尔布吕肯，与德國莱茵兰-普法尔茨州、法国洛林地區，以及卢森堡接壤。萨尔兰州與上述各地區以及比利时瓦隆大区等五處，共同构成萨洛卢，以彰顯德法雙語文化交流之在地特色。
description.zh-TW: 薩爾蘭，原名薩爾，是德國西南部的一個聯邦州，首府薩爾布呂肯，與德國萊茵蘭-普法爾茨州、法國洛林地區，以及盧森堡接壤。薩爾蘭州與上述各地區以及比利時瓦隆大區等五處，共同構成薩洛盧，以彰顯德法雙語文化交流之在地特色。

photo.credit: NASA / USGS · Landsat WELD · 2000 · Public domain

description.en: Hauts-de-France , also referred to in English as Upper France, is the northernmost region of France, created by the territorial reform of French regions in 2014, from a merger of Nord-Pas-de-Calais and Picardy. Its prefecture is Lille.
description.zh-CN: 上法蘭西大區是法国的一个大区，其根據2014年大區重劃由北部-加來海峽、皮卡第兩個大區合併而成，2016年1月1日起生效。
description.zh-TW: 上法蘭西大區是法國的一個大區，其根據2014年大區重劃由北部-加來海峽、皮卡第兩個大區合併而成，2016年1月1日起生效。

photo.alt: Place du Général de Gaulle, the central square of in Lille, northeastern France. Behind the Column of the Goddess is the bell tower of the Chamber of Commerce. The large building to the right (on the square) is the Vieille Bourse (Old Stock Market).
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Belgium, officially the Kingdom of Belgium, is a country in Northwestern Europe. Situated in a coastal lowland region known as the Low Countries, it is bordered by the Netherlands to the north, Germany to the east, Luxembourg to the southeast, France to the south, and the North Sea to the west.
description.zh-CN: 比利時王國，通稱比利時，是一个位于西欧的国家，坐落于被称之为低地国家的沿海低地地区。其领土北部与荷兰接壤，东部与德国相邻，东南毗邻卢森堡，南接法国，西濒大西洋北海。
description.zh-TW: 比利時王國，通稱比利時，是一個位於西歐的國家，坐落於被稱之爲低地國家的沿海低地地區。其領土北部與荷蘭接壤，東部與德國相鄰，東南毗鄰盧森堡，南接法國，西瀕大西洋北海。

photo.credit: NASA / USGS · Landsat WELD · 2000 · Public domain

alt.zh-TW: 比利時周邊地表，2000年Landsat真彩衛星合成影像。

description.en: Grand Est is one of France's landlocked administrative regions, this being in northeastern France. It superseded three former administrative regions, Alsace, Champagne-Ardenne, and Lorraine, on 1 January 2016 under the provisional name of Alsace-Champagne-Ardenne-Lorraine as a result of territorial reform which had been passed by the French Parliament in 2014.
description.zh-CN: 大东部是法国的大區之一，由阿爾薩斯、香檳-阿登、洛林3個大區合併而成，於2016年1月1日正式成立、同年9月28日改用現名。
description.zh-TW: 大東部是法國的大區之一，由阿爾薩斯、香檳-阿登、洛林3個大區合併而成，於2016年1月1日正式成立、同年9月28日改用現名。

photo.credit: Drew de F Fawkes · CC BY 2.0
photo.alt: View from the Château du Haut-Kœnigsbourg over the Alsatian plain up to the Black Forest
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: North Macedonia, officially the Republic of North Macedonia, is a landlocked country in Southeastern Europe. It shares borders with Greece to the south, Albania to the west, Bulgaria to the east, Kosovo to the northwest and Serbia to the north.
description.zh-CN: 北馬其頓共和國，通称北馬其頓，是位于欧洲的巴尔干半岛南部的内陆国家，东临保加利亚，西北臨科索沃，北临塞尔维亚，西临阿尔巴尼亚，南临希腊。首都與最大都市是斯科普里。
description.zh-TW: 北馬其頓共和國，通稱北馬其頓，是位於歐洲的巴爾幹半島南部的內陸國家，東臨保加利亞，西北臨科索沃，北臨塞爾維亞，西臨阿爾巴尼亞，南臨希臘。首都與最大都市是斯科普里。

description.en: Albania, officially the Republic of Albania, is a country in Southeastern Europe. It is located in the Balkans, on the Adriatic and Ionian Seas within the Mediterranean Sea, and shares land borders with Montenegro to the northwest, Kosovo to the northeast, North Macedonia to the east and Greece to the south.
description.zh-CN: 阿爾巴尼亞共和国，通稱阿爾巴尼亞，是一个位于欧洲东南部、巴爾幹半島西南部的国家。阿爾巴尼亞西临亞得里亞海和奥特朗托海峡并與意大利相望，南面與希臘接壤，東臨北馬其頓，東北是科索沃地区，北接黑山。
description.zh-TW: 阿爾巴尼亞共和國，通稱阿爾巴尼亞，是一個位於歐洲東南部、巴爾幹半島西南部的國家。阿爾巴尼亞西臨亞得裏亞海和奧特朗托海峽並與意大利相望，南面與希臘接壤，東臨北馬其頓，東北是科索沃地區，北接黑山。

description.en: Kosovo, officially the Republic of Kosovo, is a landlocked country in Southeastern Europe with partial diplomatic recognition. It is bordered by Albania to the southwest, Montenegro to the west, Serbia to the north and east, and North Macedonia to the southeast.
description.zh-CN: 科索沃共和國，通稱科索沃，位於欧洲东南部的巴尔干半岛中部内陆，是一个有主权争议的共和国。 自1999年科索沃戰爭結束以來，科索沃事实上独立，属于聯合國的託管地，並由聯合國科索沃臨時行政當局特派團臨時管治。
description.zh-TW: 科索沃共和國，通稱科索沃，位於歐洲東南部的巴爾幹半島中部內陸，是一個有主權爭議的共和國。 自1999年科索沃戰爭結束以來，科索沃事實上獨立，屬於聯合國的託管地，並由聯合國科索沃臨時行政當局特派團臨時管治。

description.en: Turkey, officially the Republic of Türkiye, is a country mainly located in Anatolia in West Asia, with a smaller part called East Thrace in Southeast Europe. It borders the Black Sea to the north; Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, and Iran to the east; Iraq, Syria, and the Mediterranean Sea to the south; and the Aegean Sea, Greece, and Bulgaria to the west.
description.zh-CN: 土耳其共和国，通稱土耳其，是橫跨欧亚两洲的共和國，其國土包括西亞的安納托利亞半岛、以及东南欧巴尔干半岛的东色雷斯地區；其中亞洲部分包含了約97%的領土與87%的人口。建立於1923年，並繼承奥斯曼帝国的國家地位。
description.zh-TW: 土耳其共和國，通稱土耳其，是橫跨歐亞兩洲的共和國，其國土包括西亞的安納託利亞半島、以及東南歐巴爾幹半島的東色雷斯地區；其中亞洲部分包含了約97%的領土與87%的人口。建立於1923年，並繼承奧斯曼帝國的國家地位。

description.en: Ceuta is an autonomous city of Spain on the North African coast. Bordered by Morocco, it lies between the Mediterranean Sea and the Atlantic Ocean.
description.zh-CN: 休达，又称塞卜泰，是西班牙的兩個自治市之一，位于非洲马格里布的最北部，直布罗陀海峡附近的地中海沿岸，与摩洛哥接壤。面积约18.5平方公里。
description.zh-TW: 休達，又稱塞卜泰，是西班牙的兩個自治市之一，位於非洲馬格里布的最北部，直布羅陀海峽附近的地中海沿岸，與摩洛哥接壤。面積約18.5平方公里。

description.en: Schleswig-Holstein, officially the State of Schleswig-Holstein, is a coastal state that is the northernmost of the sixteen states of Germany, comprising most of the historical Duchy of Holstein and the southern part of the former Duchy of Schleswig. It borders Denmark, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Lower Saxony and the city-state of Hamburg.
description.zh-CN: 石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因，简称石荷州，是德国16个州中最北面的一个州。 这个州是在第二次世界大战后设立的，其州府为有運河通過的基尔，它的面积為15,761.4平方公里，是德国非城市州中第二小的，石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因北邻丹麦，南接德国的汉堡市、梅克伦堡-前波美拉尼亚和下萨克森三州。
description.zh-TW: 石勒蘇益格-荷爾斯泰因，簡稱石荷州，是德國16個州中最北面的一個州。 這個州是在第二次世界大戰後設立的，其州府爲有運河通過的基爾，它的面積為15,761.4平方公里，是德國非城市州中第二小的，石勒蘇益格-荷爾斯泰因北鄰丹麥，南接德國的漢堡市、梅克倫堡-前波美拉尼亞和下薩克森三州。

description.en: Denmark is a Nordic country in Northern Europe. It is the metropole and most populous constituent of the Kingdom of Denmark, also known as the Danish Realm, a constitutionally unitary state that includes the autonomous territories of the Faroe Islands and Greenland in the north Atlantic Ocean.
description.zh-CN: 丹麦，是位于斯堪的纳维亚最南端的北歐國家，总面积42,943平方公里，在北欧五国中纬度最低，北倚瑞典西南部，挪威南部，南靠與德国北部接壤，是其欧洲部分唯一的陆上边境。丹麦或称丹麦本土，由日德兰半岛北部和菲英岛、西兰岛、北日德兰岛等406个岛屿组成，是丹麦王国的主体部分，也是整个丹麦王国中人口最多，都市区最集中的构成国。
description.zh-TW: 丹麥，是位於斯堪的納維亞最南端的北歐國家，總面積42,943平方公里，在北歐五國中緯度最低，北倚瑞典西南部，挪威南部，南靠與德國北部接壤，是其歐洲部分唯一的陸上邊境。丹麥或稱丹麥本土，由日德蘭半島北部和菲英島、西蘭島、北日德蘭島等406個島嶼組成，是丹麥王國的主體部分，也是整個丹麥王國中人口最多，都市區最集中的構成國。

description.en: Libya, officially the State of Libya, is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa. It borders the Mediterranean Sea to the north, Egypt to the east, Sudan to the southeast, Chad to the south, Niger to the southwest, Algeria to the west, and Tunisia to the northwest.
description.zh-CN: 利比亞國，通稱利比亞，是位於北非的國家。與埃及、蘇丹共和國、乍得、尼日尔、阿爾及利亞和突尼西亞相鄰。
description.zh-TW: 利比亞國，通稱利比亞，是位於北非的國家。與埃及、蘇丹共和國、乍得、尼日爾、阿爾及利亞和突尼西亞相鄰。

description.en: Tunisia, officially the Republic of Tunisia, is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa. It is bordered by Algeria to the west and southwest, Libya to the southeast, and the Mediterranean Sea to the north and east.
description.zh-CN: 突尼西亞共和國，通称突尼斯，是位於北非的國家，首都及最大城市為突尼斯市。此外，突尼斯隶属于马格里布地区，东部和北部緊鄰地中海。
description.zh-TW: 突尼西亞共和國，通稱突尼斯，是位於北非的國家，首都及最大城市為突尼斯市。此外，突尼斯隸屬於馬格里布地區，東部和北部緊鄰地中海。

photo.alt: Panorama of the courtyard of the Great Mosque of Kairouan, in Tunisia. This huge mosque, also called Mosque of Uqba, was founded in 670 A.D. It dates, in its present form, from the 9th century (under the Aghlabid dynasty). The Great Mosque of Kairouan is the oldest mosque in the Muslim West.

description.en: Romania is a country in Central and Southeastern Europe. It lies on the lower course of the Danube, north of the Balkan Peninsula, and on the northwestern shore of the Black Sea.
description.zh-CN: 罗马尼亚是一个位於東歐的国家。國境西方分別為匈牙利與塞爾維亞接壤，保加利亞在南方，北方與东北方則是乌克兰與摩尔多瓦共和國。
description.zh-TW: 羅馬尼亞是一個位於東歐的國家。國境西方分別為匈牙利與塞爾維亞接壤，保加利亞在南方，北方與東北方則是烏克蘭與摩爾多瓦共和國。
