description.en: Hungary is a landlocked country in Central Europe. Spanning much of the Carpathian Basin, it is bordered by Slovakia to the north, Ukraine to the northeast, Romania to the east and southeast, Serbia to the south, Croatia and Slovenia to the southwest, and Austria to the west.
description.zh-CN: 匈牙利是位於歐洲的内陆国家。根據地理分區的不同定義，匈牙利被認為處在中歐和東歐。
description.zh-TW: 匈牙利是位於歐洲的內陸國家。根據地理分區的不同定義，匈牙利被認為處在中歐和東歐。

description.en: Slovakia, officially the Slovak Republic, is a landlocked country in Central Europe. It is bordered by Poland to the north, Ukraine to the east, Hungary to the south, Austria to the west, and the Czech Republic to the northwest.
description.zh-CN: 斯洛伐克共和国，通稱斯洛伐克，位于歐洲的共和制國家，也是位於歐洲的内陆国家。根據地理分區的不同定義，斯洛伐克被認為處在中歐和東歐。
description.zh-TW: 斯洛伐克共和國，通稱斯洛伐克，位於歐洲的共和制國家，也是位於歐洲的內陸國家。根據地理分區的不同定義，斯洛伐克被認為處在中歐和東歐。

description.en: Poland, officially the Republic of Poland, is a country in Central Europe. It extends from the Baltic Sea in the north to the Sudetes and Carpathian Mountains in the south, and borders Lithuania and Russia to the northeast; Belarus and Ukraine to the east; Slovakia and the Czech Republic to the south; and Germany to the west.
description.zh-CN: 波兰共和国，通称波兰，是位於中欧和东欧的國家，首都及最大城市为华沙。国土面積313,933平方公里，位居歐洲第十；人口約3,763萬人，位居歐洲第九、欧盟第五。
description.zh-TW: 波蘭共和國，通稱波蘭，是位於中歐和東歐的國家，首都及最大城市爲華沙。國土面積313,933平方公里，位居歐洲第十；人口約3,763萬人，位居歐洲第九、歐盟第五。

description.en: Ireland is an island in the North Atlantic Ocean, in Northwestern Europe. Geopolitically, the island is divided between the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland .
description.zh-CN: 爱尔兰岛是位於欧洲西北部的大西洋島嶼，以面積計算是歐洲第三大島。島上大部分區域屬於爱尔兰共和国的領土，至於島上東北部的北愛爾蘭地區之主權則屬於英国。
description.zh-TW: 愛爾蘭島是位於歐洲西北部的大西洋島嶼，以面積計算是歐洲第三大島。島上大部分區域屬於愛爾蘭共和國的領土，至於島上東北部的北愛爾蘭地區之主權則屬於英國。

photo.alt: It is easy to see from this true-colour image why Ireland is called the Emerald Isle. Intense green vegetation, primarily grassland, covers most of the country except for the exposed rock on mountaintops. Ireland owes its greenness to moderate temperatures and moist air. The Atlantic Ocean, particularly the warm currents in the North Atlantic Drift, gives the country a more temperate climate than most others at the same latitude.
photo.modifications: Resized and converted to WebP; no content edits.

description.en: Northern Ireland is a part of the United Kingdom in the north-east of the island of Ireland. It has been variously described as a country, province or region.
description.zh-CN: 北愛爾蘭是英國的組成部分，位于爱尔兰岛东北部，擁有國家、省、地區這些不同的術語稱呼。北愛爾蘭的西部和南部與愛爾蘭共和國保持著邊境開放。
description.zh-TW: 北愛爾蘭是英國的組成部分，位於愛爾蘭島東北部，擁有國家、省、地區這些不同的術語稱呼。北愛爾蘭的西部和南部與愛爾蘭共和國保持著邊境開放。

description.en: Greece, officially the Hellenic Republic, is a country located mostly on the Balkan peninsula of Southeastern Europe, with thousands of islands extending geographically to Asia Minor. It has a population of around 10 million.
description.zh-CN: 希臘共和國，簡稱希臘，是位於歐洲南部的發達跨大陸國家。2024年其人口為1,039萬。
description.zh-TW: 希臘共和國，簡稱希臘，是位於歐洲南部的發達跨大陸國家。2024年其人口為1,039萬。

description.en: Austria, formally the Republic of Austria, is a landlocked country in Central Europe, lying in the Eastern Alps. It is a federation of nine states, of which the capital Vienna is the most populous city and state.
description.zh-CN: 奥地利共和国，通稱奥地利，是一个位於歐洲的內陸國家，被分類成西歐、中歐或者東歐的主權國家。奧地利与多國接壤，东面是匈牙利和斯洛伐克，南面是意大利和斯洛文尼亚，西面是列支敦士登和瑞士，北面是德国和捷克。
description.zh-TW: 奧地利共和國，通稱奧地利，是一個位於歐洲的內陸國家，被分類成西歐、中歐或者東歐的主權國家。奧地利與多國接壤，東面是匈牙利和斯洛伐克，南面是意大利和斯洛文尼亞，西面是列支敦士登和瑞士，北面是德國和捷克。

description.en: Iraq, officially the Republic of Iraq, is a country in West Asia. Located within the Middle East, it is bordered by Saudi Arabia to the south, Turkey to the north, Iran to the east, the Persian Gulf and Kuwait to the southeast, Jordan to the southwest, and Syria to the west.
description.zh-CN: 伊拉克共和国，通稱伊拉克，位于西亞地區的共和國。其与南方的沙特阿拉伯、科威特，北方的土耳其，西北的叙利亚，东方的伊朗及西方的约旦接壤。
description.zh-TW: 伊拉克共和國，通稱伊拉克，位於西亞地區的共和國。其與南方的沙特阿拉伯、科威特，北方的土耳其，西北的敘利亞，東方的伊朗及西方的約旦接壤。

description.en: The Aosta Valley , officially the Autonomous Region of Aosta Valley, is a mountainous autonomous region of northwestern Italy. It is bordered by Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, France, to the west; by Valais, Switzerland, to the north; and by Piedmont, Italy, to the south and east.
description.zh-CN: 瓦莱达奥斯塔，是意大利西北部的一个特殊地位大区，其西临法国奥弗涅-罗讷-阿尔卑斯大区，北方与瑞士瓦莱州接壤，东南邻皮埃蒙特大区。大区首府为奥斯塔。
description.zh-TW: 瓦萊達奧斯塔，是意大利西北部的一個特殊地位大區，其西臨法國奧弗涅-羅訥-阿爾卑斯大區，北方與瑞士瓦萊州接壤，東南鄰皮埃蒙特大區。大區首府爲奧斯塔。

description.en: Switzerland, officially the Swiss Confederation, is a landlocked country located at the intersection of Central, Western, and Southern Europe. It is bordered by Germany to the north, France to the west, Austria and Liechtenstein to the east, and Italy to the south.
description.zh-CN: 瑞士聯邦，通称瑞士，為一歐洲國家，由26個州組成。瑞士為典型的分權自治型聯邦委員會制國家，組成聯邦的各州擁有廣泛的地方自治權力，而且瑞士的國家元首為瑞士聯邦委員會全體成員，並非聯邦主席或其他特定的人。
description.zh-TW: 瑞士聯邦，通稱瑞士，為一歐洲國家，由26個州組成。瑞士為典型的分權自治型聯邦委員會制國家，組成聯邦的各州擁有廣泛的地方自治權力，而且瑞士的國家元首為瑞士聯邦委員會全體成員，並非聯邦主席或其他特定的人。

description.en: Piedmont is one of the 20 regions of Italy, located in the Northwest of the country. It borders the Liguria region to the south, the Lombardy and Emilia-Romagna regions to the east, and the Aosta Valley region to the northwest.
description.zh-CN: 皮埃蒙特是意大利西北的一个大区，面积25,402平方公里，人口數4,377,941，首府是都灵。 皮埃蒙特大区的三面被阿尔卑斯山山脉包围，包括波河的起源维素山脉，及罗莎山脉。
description.zh-TW: 皮埃蒙特是意大利西北的一個大區，面積25,402平方公里，人口數4,377,941，首府是都靈。 皮埃蒙特大區的三面被阿爾卑斯山山脈包圍，包括波河的起源維素山脈，及羅莎山脈。

description.en: Lombardy is an administrative region of Italy that covers 23,844 km2 ; it is located in northern Italy and with a population of about 10 million is the most populous region, constituting more than one-sixth of Italy's population.
description.zh-CN: 伦巴第是一个位于阿尔卑斯山和波河的一个意大利北部大区。它与意大利的其它大区皮埃蒙特、艾米利亚-罗马涅、威尼托、特伦蒂诺-上阿迪杰以及瑞士相接。
description.zh-TW: 倫巴第是一個位於阿爾卑斯山和波河的一個意大利北部大區。它與意大利的其它大區皮埃蒙特、艾米利亞-羅馬涅、威尼託、特倫蒂諾-上阿迪傑以及瑞士相接。

description.en: Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol , often known in English as Trentino-South Tyrol or by its Italian name Trentino-Alto Adige, is an autonomous region of Italy, located in the northern part of the country. The region has a population of nearly 1.1 million, of whom 62% speak Italian as their mother tongue , 30% speak German , and the remaining are minority speakers of Ladin, Mòcheno or Cimbrian and immigrant communities speaking several foreign languages.
description.zh-CN: 特伦蒂诺-上阿迪杰，德语与拉定语称特伦蒂诺-南蒂罗尔，正式名称为特伦蒂诺-上阿迪杰/南蒂罗尔，是意大利北部的一个特殊地位大区。该自治区由两个分区组成，分别是多数人说意大利语的特伦托省及多数人说德语的南蒂罗尔省。
description.zh-TW: 特倫蒂諾-上阿迪傑，德語與拉定語稱特倫蒂諾-南蒂羅爾，正式名稱爲特倫蒂諾-上阿迪傑/南蒂羅爾，是意大利北部的一個特殊地位大區。該自治區由兩個分區組成，分別是多數人說意大利語的特倫託省及多數人說德語的南蒂羅爾省。

description.en: The Netherlands, also informally known as Holland, is a country in Northwestern Europe, with overseas territories in the Caribbean. It is the largest of the four constituent countries of the Kingdom of the Netherlands.
description.zh-CN: 尼德蘭，中文通稱荷蘭，是位于欧洲西部的低地国家，由歐洲區荷蘭的12個省份和荷蘭加勒比區的博奈爾島、聖尤斯特歇斯島和薩巴島組成。荷蘭也是荷蘭王國的四个構成國之一，与美洲加勒比地区的阿鲁巴、库拉索和荷屬聖馬丁共同组成荷蘭王國。
description.zh-TW: 尼德蘭，中文通稱荷蘭，是位於歐洲西部的低地國家，由歐洲區荷蘭的12個省份和荷蘭加勒比區的博奈爾島、聖尤斯特歇斯島和薩巴島組成。荷蘭也是荷蘭王國的四個構成國之一，與美洲加勒比地區的阿魯巴、庫拉索和荷屬聖馬丁共同組成荷蘭王國。

description.en: Lower Saxony is a coastal state in northwestern Germany. It is the second-largest state by land area, with 47,614 km2 , and fourth-largest in population among the 16 Länder of the Federal Republic of Germany.
description.zh-CN: 下萨克森州，位于德国西北部，与荷兰接壤，面积达47600平方公里，仅次于巴伐利亚州，是德国第二大联邦州。人口800万，列第四位，次于北莱茵-威斯特法伦州、巴伐利亚州、巴登-符腾堡州，州首府是汉诺威。
description.zh-TW: 下薩克森州，位於德國西北部，與荷蘭接壤，面積達47600平方公里，僅次於巴伐利亞州，是德國第二大聯邦州。人口800萬，列第四位，次於北萊茵-威斯特法倫州、巴伐利亞州、巴登-符騰堡州，州首府是漢諾威。

description.en: North Rhine-Westphalia or North-Rhine/Westphalia , commonly shortened to NRW, is a landlocked state in Western Germany. With more than 18 million inhabitants, it is the most populous state in Germany.
description.zh-CN: 北莱茵-威斯特法伦州是德国人口最多、GDP最高的一個联邦州，總面积34,080平方公里，首府位於杜塞尔多夫。该州坐落於德国西部，与比利时及荷兰接壤，总人口超过1,800万，为德国人口第一大州。
description.zh-TW: 北萊茵-威斯特法倫州是德國人口最多、GDP最高的一個聯邦州，總面積34,080平方公里，首府位於杜塞爾多夫。該州坐落於德國西部，與比利時及荷蘭接壤，總人口超過1,800萬，爲德國人口第一大州。

description.en: Liechtenstein , officially the Principality of Liechtenstein , is a doubly landlocked country in the Central European Alps. A microstate, it is located between Austria to the east and north-east and Switzerland to the north-west, west and south.
description.zh-CN: 列支敦士登公國，通稱列支敦士登，是位於歐洲的內陸國家，聯合國區域集團定義為西歐國家，也是全球唯二雙重內陸國之一，夾在瑞士與奧地利兩國間。该国也是唯一一个德语是官方语言，但与德国没有交界的国家。
description.zh-TW: 列支敦士登公國，通稱列支敦士登，是位於歐洲的內陸國家，聯合國區域集團定義為西歐國家，也是全球唯二雙重內陸國之一，夾在瑞士與奧地利兩國間。該國也是唯一一個德語是官方語言，但與德國沒有交界的國家。

description.en: Liguria is a region of north-western Italy; its capital is Genoa. Its territory is crossed by the Alps and the Apennines mountain range and is roughly coextensive with the former territory of the Republic of Genoa.
description.zh-CN: 利古里亚是意大利西北部的一个邻海大区，是意大利众大区中第三小的。大区西临法国，北界与皮埃蒙特大区相邻，东临艾米利亚-罗马涅大区及托斯卡纳大区。
description.zh-TW: 利古里亞是意大利西北部的一個鄰海大區，是意大利衆大區中第三小的。大區西臨法國，北界與皮埃蒙特大區相鄰，東臨艾米利亞-羅馬涅大區及托斯卡納大區。

description.en: Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur , sometimes known as Région Sud, is one of the eighteen administrative regions of France, located at the far southeastern point of the mainland. The main prefecture and largest city is Marseille, France's second largest city proper after Paris and the 2nd largest urban area when combined with Aix-en-Provence with over 1.9 million residents.
description.zh-CN: 普罗旺斯-阿尔卑斯-蔚蓝海岸大区，简称普阿蓝大区，是法国東南部的一個大區，首府马赛。 普阿蓝大区南鄰地中海，面积31,400平方公里，人口4,506,151人。
description.zh-TW: 普羅旺斯-阿爾卑斯-蔚藍海岸大區，簡稱普阿藍大區，是法國東南部的一個大區，首府馬賽。 普阿藍大區南鄰地中海，面積31,400平方公里，人口4,506,151人。

description.en: Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes is a landlocked region in Southern France. It was created by the 2014 territorial reform of French regions; it resulted from the merger of Auvergne and Rhône-Alpes.
description.zh-CN: 奧弗涅-羅訥-阿爾卑斯，简称奥罗阿大区，是法國的一个大區，首府里昂。奥罗阿大区是根據2014年大區重劃规划，合併了奥弗涅、罗讷-阿尔卑斯兩個大區的新大区，已于2016年1月1日起生效。
description.zh-TW: 奧弗涅-羅訥-阿爾卑斯，簡稱奧羅阿大區，是法國的一個大區，首府里昂。奧羅阿大區是根據2014年大區重劃規劃，合併了奧弗涅、羅訥-阿爾卑斯兩個大區的新大區，已於2016年1月1日起生效。

description.en: Serbia, officially the Republic of Serbia, is a landlocked country in Southeastern and Central Europe. It is bordered by Hungary to the north, Romania to the northeast, Bulgaria to the southeast, North Macedonia to the south, Croatia to the northwest, Bosnia and Herzegovina to the west, Montenegro to the southwest, and it also claims a border with Albania through the disputed territory of Kosovo.
description.zh-CN: 塞尔维亚共和国，简称塞尔维亚，是一個巴爾幹半島內陸國，位於歐洲東南部和中部、巴爾幹半島中部、潘諾尼亞平原之上，系屬中東歐或東歐國家。北邻匈牙利，东北有羅馬尼亞，东南有保加利亞，南与北馬其頓接壤，西南有黑山，西边的邻国则是波士尼亞與赫塞哥維納、克羅地亞。
description.zh-TW: 塞爾維亞共和國，簡稱塞爾維亞，是一個巴爾幹半島內陸國，位於歐洲東南部和中部、巴爾幹半島中部、潘諾尼亞平原之上，系屬中東歐或東歐國家。北鄰匈牙利，東北有羅馬尼亞，東南有保加利亞，南與北馬其頓接壤，西南有黑山，西邊的鄰國則是波士尼亞與赫塞哥維納、克羅地亞。

description.en: Mali, officially the Republic of Mali, is a landlocked country in West Africa. It is the eighth-largest country in Africa and the 23rd largest country in the world, with an area of 1,240,192 square kilometres .
description.zh-CN: 马里共和国，通稱馬里，是位於西非萨赫勒地区的内陆国家，北部地區北接阿尔及利亚、东接尼日尔、西面毛里塔尼亚，南部西接塞内加尔、西南接几内亚、南鄰布基纳法索和科特迪瓦，是西非面积第二大的国家。其北面國界深入撒哈拉沙漠腹地，人口主要集中在南部，尼日尔河和塞内加尔河皆源于此。
description.zh-TW: 馬裏共和國，通稱馬裏，是位於西非薩赫勒地區的內陸國家，北部地區北接阿爾及利亞、東接尼日爾、西面毛里塔尼亞，南部西接塞內加爾、西南接幾內亞、南鄰布基納法索和科特迪瓦，是西非面積第二大的國家。其北面國界深入撒哈拉沙漠腹地，人口主要集中在南部，尼日爾河和塞內加爾河皆源於此。

description.en: Croatia, officially the Republic of Croatia, is a country in Central and Southeastern Europe, on the coast of the Adriatic Sea. It borders Slovenia to the northwest, Hungary to the northeast, Serbia to the east, Bosnia and Herzegovina and Montenegro to the southeast, and shares a maritime border with Italy to the west.
description.zh-CN: 克羅埃西亞共和國，通稱克羅埃西亞，是位於東歐、地中海和中歐交會處的單一議會共和制國家，首都與最大城市為萨格勒布。克國將行政區劃分為20個縣與一個直轄市兼首都的萨格勒布，其領土面積為56,538平方公里。
description.zh-TW: 克羅埃西亞共和國，通稱克羅埃西亞，是位於東歐、地中海和中歐交會處的單一議會共和制國家，首都與最大城市為薩格勒布。克國將行政區劃分為20個縣與一個直轄市兼首都的薩格勒布，其領土面積為56,538平方公里。

description.en: Slovenia, officially the Republic of Slovenia, is a country in Central Europe. It borders Italy to its west, Austria to its north, Hungary to its northeast, and Croatia to its south and southeast; its southwestern boundary consists of a 46.6-kilometre coastline on the Adriatic Sea.
description.zh-CN: 斯洛維尼亞共和国，通稱斯洛文尼亚，是一個位於中東歐，毗鄰阿爾卑斯山的國家。西鄰意大利，西南通往亞得里亞海，東部和南部被克罗地亚包圍，東北有匈牙利，北接奧地利。
description.zh-TW: 斯洛維尼亞共和國，通稱斯洛文尼亞，是一個位於中東歐，毗鄰阿爾卑斯山的國家。西鄰意大利，西南通往亞得裏亞海，東部和南部被克羅地亞包圍，東北有匈牙利，北接奧地利。

description.en: Saudi Arabia, officially the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia , is a country in West Asia that occupies the bulk of the Arabian Peninsula. Covering a land area of approximately 2,149,690 km2 , it is the fifth-largest country in Asia and the twelfth-largest in the world.
description.zh-CN: 沙烏地阿拉伯王國，簡稱沙烏地阿拉伯或沙烏地，是位於西亞阿拉伯半島的主權國家。沙烏地阿拉伯地處中東核心地帶，西臨紅海，東瀕波斯灣，北部與約旦、伊拉克及科威特接壤，東部與巴林、卡塔爾及阿拉伯聯合酋長國相鄰，東南接壤阿曼，南與也門交界。
description.zh-TW: 沙烏地阿拉伯王國，簡稱沙烏地阿拉伯或沙烏地，是位於西亞阿拉伯半島的主權國家。沙烏地阿拉伯地處中東核心地帶，西臨紅海，東瀕波斯灣，北部與約旦、伊拉克及科威特接壤，東部與巴林、卡塔爾及阿拉伯聯合酋長國相鄰，東南接壤阿曼，南與也門交界。

description.en: Bulgaria, officially the Republic of Bulgaria, is a country in Southeastern Europe. It is situated on the eastern portion of the Balkans directly south of the Danube river and west of the Black Sea.
description.zh-CN: 保加利亚共和国，通稱保加利亞，是一個位於巴尔干半岛東北部上的国家，系屬東歐或東南歐。它与罗马尼亚、塞尔维亚、北马其顿、希腊和土耳其接壤，东部滨临黑海，近地中海。
description.zh-TW: 保加利亞共和國，通稱保加利亞，是一個位於巴爾幹半島東北部上的國家，系屬東歐或東南歐。它與羅馬尼亞、塞爾維亞、北馬其頓、希臘和土耳其接壤，東部濱臨黑海，近地中海。

description.en: Melilla is an autonomous city of Spain on the North African coast. It lies on the eastern side of the Cape Three Forks, on the Morocco–Spain border, adjacent to the Moroccan port town of Beni Ansar, and faces the Mediterranean Sea.
description.zh-CN: 梅利利亚是西班牙的兩個自治市之一，為西班牙位於北非的海外属地，它位于地中海沿岸和马格里布的最北部。

description.en: San Marino, officially the Republic of San Marino, is a landlocked country in Southern Europe, completely surrounded by Italy. Located on the northeastern slopes of the Apennine Mountains, it is the larger of two microstates within the Italian Peninsula, the other being Vatican City.
description.zh-CN: 聖馬力諾共和國，通稱聖馬力諾，其位于意大利半岛的亚平宁山脉东北侧，处于被意大利包围的国中国状态。圣马力诺国土面积61.2平方公里，人口33,344人。
description.zh-TW: 聖馬力諾共和國，通稱聖馬力諾，其位於意大利半島的亞平寧山脈東北側，處於被意大利包圍的國中國狀態。聖馬力諾國土面積61.2平方公里，人口33,344人。

description.en: Emilia-Romagna is an administrative region of northern Italy, comprising the historical regions of Emilia and Romagna. Its capital is Bologna.
description.zh-CN: 艾米利亚-罗马涅是位于意大利北部的大区，由历史上的两个大区艾米利亚和罗马涅组成。辖区形状如三角形，东临亚得里亚海，北界隔波河与伦巴第大区和威尼托大区毗邻，西临皮埃蒙特和利古里亚大区，托斯卡纳大区、马尔凯大区和圣马力诺共和国位于其南部。
description.zh-TW: 艾米利亞-羅馬涅是位於意大利北部的大區，由歷史上的兩個大區艾米利亞和羅馬涅組成。轄區形狀如三角形，東臨亞得里亞海，北界隔波河與倫巴第大區和威尼託大區毗鄰，西臨皮埃蒙特和利古里亞大區，托斯卡納大區、馬爾凱大區和聖馬力諾共和國位於其南部。

description.en: Marche , in English sometimes referred to as the Marches , is one of the twenty regions of Italy. The region is located in the central area of the country, and has a population of nearly 1.5 million people, being the thirteenth largest region in the country by number of inhabitants.
description.zh-CN: 马尔凯是意大利中部的一个大区，北界与艾米利亚-罗马涅大区相邻，西北为托斯卡纳大区，西邻翁布里亚大区，南邻阿布鲁佐大区和拉齐奥大区，而东面则有亚得里亚海。 大区的首府是安科纳。
description.zh-TW: 馬爾凱是意大利中部的一個大區，北界與艾米利亞-羅馬涅大區相鄰，西北爲托斯卡納大區，西鄰翁布里亞大區，南鄰阿布魯佐大區和拉齊奧大區，而東面則有亞得里亞海。 大區的首府是安科納。

description.en: Veneto, officially the Region of Veneto, is one of the 20 regions of Italy, located in the north-east of the country. It is the 4th most populous region in Italy, with a population of 4,857,460 as of 2026.
description.zh-CN: 威尼托是意大利东北部的一个大区，人口約500萬，在意大利排名第四。其边界与伦巴第、特伦蒂诺-上阿迪杰、奥地利、弗留利-威尼斯朱利亚和艾米利亚-罗马涅接壤，在阿尔卑斯山和亚得里亚海之间。
description.zh-TW: 威尼託是意大利東北部的一個大區，人口約500萬，在意大利排名第四。其邊界與倫巴第、特倫蒂諾-上阿迪傑、奧地利、弗留利-威尼斯朱利亞和艾米利亞-羅馬涅接壤，在阿爾卑斯山和亞得里亞海之間。

description.en: Friuli-Venezia Giulia is one of the 20 regions of Italy and one of five autonomous regions with special statute. The regional capital is Trieste on the Gulf of Trieste, a bay of the Adriatic Sea.
description.zh-CN: 弗留利-威尼斯朱利亚，面积7856km²，人口118万，是意大利东北部的一个大区，也是意大利5个特殊地位大区之一，毗邻威尼托大区、奥地利、斯洛文尼亚和亚得里亚海。主要城市是的里雅斯特和乌迪内。
description.zh-TW: 弗留利-威尼斯朱利亞，面積7856km²，人口118萬，是意大利東北部的一個大區，也是意大利5個特殊地位大區之一，毗鄰威尼託大區、奧地利、斯洛文尼亞和亞得里亞海。主要城市是的裏雅斯特和烏迪內。

description.en: Monaco, officially the Principality of Monaco, is a sovereign city-state and microstate in Western Europe. Situated on the French Riviera, it is a semi-enclave bordered by France to the north, east, and west, with the Mediterranean Sea to the south; the Italian region of Liguria is about 15 km east.
description.zh-CN: 摩納哥公國，又称摩纳哥大公国、摩纳哥亲王国，通稱摩納哥，是一个位于西欧或南歐的城邦。摩納哥地处法国南部，除了靠地中海的南部海岸線之外，全境北、西、東三面皆由法國包圍，主要是由摩纳哥旧城和随后建立起来的週遭地区组成。
description.zh-TW: 摩納哥公國，又稱摩納哥大公國、摩納哥親王國，通稱摩納哥，是一個位於西歐或南歐的城邦。摩納哥地處法國南部，除了靠地中海的南部海岸線之外，全境北、西、東三面皆由法國包圍，主要是由摩納哥舊城和隨後建立起來的週遭地區組成。

description.en: Algeria, officially the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria, is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa. It is bordered to the northeast by Tunisia; to the east by Libya; to the southeast by Niger; to the southwest by Mali, Mauritania, and Western Sahara; to the west by Morocco; and to the north by the Mediterranean Sea.
description.zh-CN: 阿爾及利亞民主人民共和國，通稱阿爾及利亞，是北非马格里布地区的一个半总统制共和国，首都及最大城市为阿尔及尔。阿尔及利亚国土北临地中海，东邻利比亚、突尼斯，东南和南部分别与尼日尔、馬利和毛里塔尼亚接壤，西部和摩洛哥相连。
description.zh-TW: 阿爾及利亞民主人民共和國，通稱阿爾及利亞，是北非馬格里布地區的一個半總統制共和國，首都及最大城市爲阿爾及爾。阿爾及利亞國土北臨地中海，東鄰利比亞、突尼斯，東南和南部分別與尼日爾、馬利和毛里塔尼亞接壤，西部和摩洛哥相連。

description.en: Nouvelle-Aquitaine is the largest administrative region in France by area, located in the west and southwest of Metropolitan France. It was created in 2014 from the merger of Aquitaine, Limousin, and Poitou-Charentes in a territorial reform.
description.zh-CN: 新阿基坦是法國的一个大區，根據2014年大區重劃，合併阿基坦、利穆赞、普瓦图-夏朗德等三個大區而来，2016年1月1日起生效。首府與最大城市為波爾多。
description.zh-TW: 新阿基坦是法國的一個大區，根據2014年大區重劃，合併阿基坦、利穆贊、普瓦圖-夏朗德等三個大區而來，2016年1月1日起生效。首府與最大城市為波爾多。

photo.alt: Les chateaux et manoirs du Perigord, le chateau de La Roque en Perigord noir, ici vue d’ensemble N.E. en automne, le chateau est bati a mi coteau au-dessus d’un vallon au N.E. de Saint-Cyprien, juchee a l’extremite d’une etroite terrasse la construction s’est developpee en hauteur ce qui lui confere sa silhouette massive et imposante, les Beaumont-Beynac vendirent le chateau en 1948, il a depuis lors connu divers proprietaires et fut du XVIIIe siecle jusqu’a nos jours incessamment remanie, embelli, modernise et amenage en residence confortable, on a heureusement preserve le remarquable ensemble de fresques decorant l’oratoire, edifice protege au titre des monuments historiques, photo prise apres avoir obtenu l’autorisation du proprietaire, commune de Meyrals, Dordogne, France, Europe.

description.en: Navarre, officially the Chartered Community of Navarre, is a landlocked foral autonomous community and province in northern Spain, bordering the Basque Autonomous Community, La Rioja, and Aragon in Spain and Nouvelle-Aquitaine in France. The capital city is Pamplona .
description.zh-CN: 纳瓦拉特许共同体，通称纳瓦拉自治区，简称纳瓦拉，是西班牙北部的一個自治區。自治区仅辖纳瓦拉一省，总面积10,391平方千米，2017年总人口643,234。
description.zh-TW: 納瓦拉特許共同體，通稱納瓦拉自治區，簡稱納瓦拉，是西班牙北部的一個自治區。自治區僅轄納瓦拉一省，總面積10,391平方千米，2017年總人口643,234。

description.en: The Basque Country or Basque Autonomous Community, also officially called Euskadi, is an autonomous community in northern Spain. It includes the Basque provinces of Álava , Biscay , and Gipuzkoa .
description.zh-CN: 巴斯克地区自治区，是西班牙中北部的一个自治区，北临比斯开湾，东北隔比利牛斯山脉与法国相邻。西部与坎塔布里亚自治区和卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂自治区相邻。
description.zh-TW: 巴斯克地區自治區，是西班牙中北部的一個自治區，北臨比斯開灣，東北隔比利牛斯山脈與法國相鄰。西部與坎塔布里亞自治區和卡斯蒂利亞-萊昂自治區相鄰。

description.en: Aragon is an autonomous community in Spain, coextensive with the medieval Kingdom of Aragon. In northeastern Spain, the Aragonese autonomous community comprises three provinces : Huesca, Zaragoza, and Teruel.
description.zh-CN: 亞拉岡自治區，通稱亞拉岡，是位於伊比利亞半島東北部的內陸地區，為西班牙的自治區之一，全境面積達47,719平方公里。阿拉贡向北与法国相邻，向东是加泰罗尼亚自治区，向南是巴伦西亚自治区，向西是卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼查自治区、卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂自治区、拉里奥哈自治区和納瓦拉自治區。
description.zh-TW: 亞拉岡自治區，通稱亞拉岡，是位於伊比利亞半島東北部的內陸地區，為西班牙的自治區之一，全境面積達47,719平方公里。阿拉貢向北與法國相鄰，向東是加泰羅尼亞自治區，向南是巴倫西亞自治區，向西是卡斯蒂利亞-拉曼查自治區、卡斯蒂利亞-萊昂自治區、拉里奧哈自治區和納瓦拉自治區。

description.en: Occitania is the southernmost administrative region of metropolitan France excluding Corsica, located in the south of the country, created on 1 January 2016 from the former regions of Languedoc-Roussillon and Midi-Pyrénées. The Council of State approved Occitania as the new name of the region on 28 September 2016, coming into effect on 30 September 2016.
description.zh-CN: 奥克西塔尼大区是法国的一级行政区划单位大区，于2016年1月1日正式成立，并于同年9月28日正式命名。该大区由原来的朗格多克-鲁西永和南比利牛斯两个大区合并而成。
description.zh-TW: 奧克西塔尼大區是法國的一級行政區劃單位大區，於2016年1月1日正式成立，並於同年9月28日正式命名。該大區由原來的朗格多克-魯西永和南比利牛斯兩個大區合併而成。

description.en: Catalonia is an autonomous community of Spain, designated as a nationality by its Statute of Autonomy. Its territory is situated on the northeast of the Iberian Peninsula, to the south of the Pyrenees mountain range.
description.zh-CN: 加泰隆尼亞自治區，通稱加泰隆尼亞，是位於伊比利亞半島東北部的地區，為西班牙的自治區之一，下轄巴塞隆納、萊里達、赫羅納、塔拉戈納等4省，首府為巴塞隆納市。該地區與法國及安道爾接壤，東鄰地中海，全境面積達32,108平方公里。
description.zh-TW: 加泰隆尼亞自治區，通稱加泰隆尼亞，是位於伊比利亞半島東北部的地區，為西班牙的自治區之一，下轄巴塞隆納、萊裏達、赫羅納、塔拉戈納等4省，首府為巴塞隆納市。該地區與法國及安道爾接壤，東鄰地中海，全境面積達32,108平方公里。

description.en: Andorra, officially the Principality of Andorra, is a landlocked country on the Iberian Peninsula, in the eastern Pyrenees in southwestern Europe, bordered by France to the north and Spain to the south. Believed to have been created by Charlemagne, Andorra was ruled by the count of Urgell until 988, when it was transferred to the Diocese of Urgell.
description.zh-CN: 安道尔公国，又譯安道尔侯国、安道爾親王國，通稱安道爾，是一個微型国家，国土面积468平方公里，是現今歐洲大陸僅存的采邑主教國，位于比利牛斯山脉东南部，毗邻法国和西班牙。首都為安道尔城。
description.zh-TW: 安道爾公國，又譯安道爾侯國、安道爾親王國，通稱安道爾，是一個微型國家，國土面積468平方公里，是現今歐洲大陸僅存的采邑主教國，位於比利牛斯山脈東南部，毗鄰法國和西班牙。首都為安道爾城。

description.en: Montenegro is a country in Southeastern Europe, on the Balkan Peninsula. Its 25 municipalities have a total population of 633,158 people in an area of 13,883 km2 .
description.zh-CN: 黑山是一個位於歐洲巴尔干半岛西南部、亞得里亞海東岸上的多山國家。黑山的東北為塞爾維亞，東為科索沃，東南為阿爾巴尼亞，西北為波士尼亞與赫塞哥維納以及克羅埃西亞，西南則為亞得里亞海。
description.zh-TW: 黑山是一個位於歐洲巴爾幹半島西南部、亞得裏亞海東岸上的多山國家。黑山的東北為塞爾維亞，東為科索沃，東南為阿爾巴尼亞，西北為波士尼亞與赫塞哥維納以及克羅埃西亞，西南則為亞得裏亞海。

description.en: Bosnia and Herzegovina, often referred to as Bosnia-Herzegovina or simply Bosnia, is a country in Southeastern Europe. Situated on the Balkan Peninsula, it borders Serbia to the east, Montenegro to the southeast, and Croatia to the north and southwest, with a 20-kilometre-long coast on the Adriatic Sea in the south.
description.zh-CN: 波斯尼亞和黑塞哥維那，簡稱波黑，有時亦簡稱為波士尼亞，是歐洲東南部巴爾幹半島西部的主權國家，首都薩拉熱窩。該國擁有約20公里亞得里亞海海岸線，北及西南接克羅地亞，東鄰塞爾維亞，東南毗黑山。
description.zh-TW: 波斯尼亞和黑塞哥維那，簡稱波黑，有時亦簡稱為波士尼亞，是歐洲東南部巴爾幹半島西部的主權國家，首都薩拉熱窩。該國擁有約20公里亞得裏亞海海岸線，北及西南接克羅地亞，東鄰塞爾維亞，東南毗黑山。

description.en: Baden-Württemberg , commonly shortened to BW or BaWü, is a landlocked state in Southwest Germany, east of the Rhine, which forms the southern part of the country's western border with France. With more than 11.07 million inhabitants as of 2019 across a total area of nearly 35,752 km2 , it is the third-largest German state by both area and population .
description.zh-CN: 巴登-符騰堡州，通常簡稱為巴符州，是德國西南部的一個州，位於萊茵河以東，巴伐利亚州以西，萊茵河在此形成了德國南部與法國東部的天然邊界。截至2019年，該州擁有超過1107萬居民，總面積近35,752平方公里），在面積和人口上都堪稱德國的第三大州。
description.zh-TW: 巴登-符騰堡州，通常簡稱為巴符州，是德國西南部的一個州，位於萊茵河以東，巴伐利亞州以西，萊茵河在此形成了德國南部與法國東部的天然邊界。截至2019年，該州擁有超過1107萬居民，總面積近35,752平方公里），在面積和人口上都堪稱德國的第三大州。

description.en: Bourgogne-Franche-Comté is a region in France created by the 2014 territorial reform of French regions, from a merger of Burgundy and Franche-Comté. description.en: Portugal, officially the Portuguese Republic, is a country in Southwestern Europe. Mainland Portugal is located on the southwestern portion of the Iberian Peninsula, and bordered by Spain to the north and east.

description.en: Brandenburg, officially the State of Brandenburg , is a landlocked state in northeastern Germany. Brandenburg borders Poland and the states of Berlin, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Lower Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt, and Saxony.

description.en: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern , often known by its anglicised name Mecklenburg–West Pomerania, is a coastal state in the north-east of Germany. Of the country's sixteen states, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern ranks 14th in population; it covers an area of 23,300 km2 , making it the sixth largest German state in area; and it is 16th in population density.

description.en: Gibraltar is a British Overseas Territory and city located near the southern tip of the Iberian Peninsula, on the Bay of Gibraltar, near the exit of the Mediterranean Sea into the Atlantic Ocean . It has an area of 6.8 km2 and is bordered to the north by Spain .

description.en: British Columbia is the westernmost province of Canada. Situated in the Pacific Northwest between the Pacific Ocean and the Rocky Mountains, the province has a diverse geography, with rugged landscapes that include rocky coastlines, sandy beaches, forests, lakes, mountains, inland deserts, and grassy plains.

description.zh-TW: 不列顛哥倫比亞，或譯英屬哥倫比亞、中文另外又稱BC省，是加拿大最西部的省，西面瀕臨太平洋和阿拉斯加狹地，北面與育空和西北地區相連，東面隔着加拿大洛磯山脈與艾伯塔省接壤，南面與美國的華盛頓州、愛達荷州和蒙大拿州相鄰。該省面積944,735平方公里，是加拿大面積第3大的省，在加拿大各省及地區面積中排名第5。

description.en: Montana is a landlocked state in the Mountain West subregion of the Western United States. It is bordered by Idaho to the west, North Dakota to the east, South Dakota to the southeast, Wyoming to the south, and the Canadian provinces of Alberta, British Columbia, and Saskatchewan to the north.
description.zh-CN: 蒙大拿州是美國西北部的一州，州名來自於西班牙語的「montaña」，此州的面積381,156平方公里，在美國名列第四大，相當於日本國土面積大約100.5%，然而相對之下，人口相當稀少，據2025年估計僅1,144,694人，人口密度也相當低，經濟上以農牧為主，作物主要有燕麥、大麥和甜菜，亦有重要的採礦和伐木業。 此州的西邊有三分之一都是山脈，在東邊則有三分之二還屬於美國大平原的範圍。

photo.credit: Bureau of Land Management · Public domain
photo.alt: Our July #conservationlands15 Bucket List Location: Take a step back in time and paddle through history along the BLM Upper Missouri Wild and Scenic River in Montana “The hills and river Clifts which we passed today exhibit a most romantic appearance…. The bluffs of the river rise to hight of from 2 to 300 feet and in most places nearly perpendicular; they are formed of remarkable white sandstone which is sufficiently soft to give way readily to the impression of water…” Meriwether Lewis, May 31, 1805. You can camp in the same locations as the 1805 Lewis and Clark expedition on your multi-day canoe expedition down the “Big Muddy”. The river is a relatively easy paddle with current and riffles but no major rapids. Along the way, camp under the shade of spreading cottonwoods and try your luck catching a paddlefish – some weigh over 100 pounds. The Breaks Country surrounding the river offers opportunities for scrambles and cross country hikes to the bluffs above. The unique geology and harsh landscapes that were extensively described by Lewis and Clark are in a condition that has changed little since the passage of the expedition. Historic homesteads dot the river banks, and remnants of the steamboat era remain in inscriptions that were etched on the rock walls. Photo by Bob Wick, BLM

description.zh-CN: 宾夕法尼亚州是美國的州份之一，俗称“拱心石州”，或稱宾夕凡尼亚州，中文簡稱賓州。這個州的名稱起源于英国移民威廉·賓，英國國王查理二世為償還欠其父親的薪资而授予大片林地，拉丁文中的意思是“賓的林地”。

description.en: New York, also called New York State, is a state located in the Northeastern United States. Bordering New England to its east, Pennsylvania and New Jersey to the south, and Canada to its north, New York extends into both the Atlantic Ocean and the Great Lakes.

description.zh-TW: 紐約州，別稱帝國州，是位於美國東北部的一個州，首府為奧爾巴尼，最大城市紐約市。紐約州西部及北部與加拿大魁北克省和安大略省接壤，東鄰馬薩諸塞州、康涅狄格州、佛蒙特州和大西洋，南接賓夕法尼亞州、新澤西州，西北部連接五大湖之一的安大略湖。

description.en: New Hampshire is a state in the New England region of the Northeastern United States. It borders Massachusetts to the south, Vermont to the west, Maine and the Gulf of Maine to the east, and the Canadian province of Quebec to the north.

description.en: New Brunswick is a province of Canada. It borders Quebec to the northwest, the Gulf of Saint Lawrence to the northeast, Nova Scotia to the east, the Bay of Fundy to the southeast, and the U.S. state of Maine to the southwest.
description.zh-CN: 新不伦瑞克省，簡稱新省，是加拿大大西洋地区的一个省级行政区，全省人口逾77萬，英语和法语同为新不伦瑞克的官方语言，约65%的人口說英语、32%的人口說法语，是次于魁北克加拿大法语人口第二多的省份。新不伦瑞克也是加拿大唯一一个英法均为官方语言的省份，1993年加拿大宪法修正案确保了在新不伦瑞克省的英语人群和法语人群有着平等的社会权利。
description.zh-TW: 新不倫瑞克省，簡稱新省，是加拿大大西洋地區的一個省級行政區，全省人口逾77萬，英語和法語同爲新不倫瑞克的官方語言，約65%的人口說英語、32%的人口說法語，是次於魁北克加拿大法語人口第二多的省份。新不倫瑞克也是加拿大唯一一個英法均爲官方語言的省份，1993年加拿大憲法修正案確保了在新不倫瑞克省的英語人羣和法語人羣有着平等的社會權利。

photo.alt: The origin of this classic, simple meteorite impact crater was long the subject of controversy. The discovery of fragments of the Canyon Diablo meteorite, including fragments within the breccia deposits that partially fill the structure, and the presence of a range of shock-metamorphic features in the target sandstone, confirmed its impact origin. Target rocks include Paleozoic carbonates and sandstones; these rocks have been overturned just outside the rim during ejection. The hummocky deposits just beyond the rim are remnants of the ejecta blanket. This aerial view shows the dramatic expression of the crater in the arid landscape.

It is the northernmost country in Latin America, bordering the United States of America to the north and Guatemala and Belize to the southeast, while having maritime boundaries with the Pacific Ocean to the west, the Caribbean Sea to the southeast, and the Gulf of Mexico to the east.

description.en: Northern Cyprus, officially the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus , is a de facto state comprising the northern third of the island of Cyprus. It is recognised only by Turkey, with the international community considering it territory of the Republic of Cyprus under Turkish military occupation.
description.zh-CN: 北賽普勒斯土耳其共和國，通稱北塞浦路斯，位於地中海東部的賽普勒斯島北部，是一個主權爭端地區及有限承認國家。北賽普勒斯是在1974年由賽普勒斯島上的土耳其人後裔宣佈獨立建國，政權控制了島上北邊約1/3面積的領土，但目前全世界只有土耳其承認北賽普勒斯的政權，在國際法上被認為是傀儡國家。
description.zh-TW: 北賽普勒斯土耳其共和國，通稱北塞浦路斯，位於地中海東部的賽普勒斯島北部，是一個主權爭端地區及有限承認國家。北賽普勒斯是在1974年由賽普勒斯島上的土耳其人後裔宣佈獨立建國，政權控制了島上北邊約1/3面積的領土，但目前全世界只有土耳其承認北賽普勒斯的政權，在國際法上被認為是傀儡國家。

description.en: Akrotiri and Dhekelia , officially the Sovereign Base Areas of Akrotiri and Dhekelia , is a British Overseas Territory that consists of two separate areas on the island of Cyprus. The areas, which include British military bases and installations that were formerly part of the Crown colony of Cyprus, were retained by the British under the 1960 treaty of independence signed by the United Kingdom, Greece, Turkey, the president of Cyprus and the representative of the Turkish Cypriot community.
description.zh-CN: 亞克羅提利與德凱利亞主权基地区是兩個位於地中海極東部島嶼賽普勒斯上的英國特殊屬地，共同組成了英屬基地區，其中亞克羅提利位於賽普勒斯島南部，德凱利亞則位於島上的東南隅。 英屬基地區是一種英國在海外擁有的特殊军事基地單位。
description.zh-TW: 亞克羅提利與德凱利亞主權基地區是兩個位於地中海極東部島嶼賽普勒斯上的英國特殊屬地，共同組成了英屬基地區，其中亞克羅提利位於賽普勒斯島南部，德凱利亞則位於島上的東南隅。 英屬基地區是一種英國在海外擁有的特殊軍事基地單位。

description.en: Galicia is an autonomous community of Spain and historic nationality under Spanish law. Located in the northwest Iberian Peninsula, it includes the provinces of A Coruña, Lugo, Ourense, and Pontevedra.
description.zh-CN: 加利西亚自治区是组成西班牙的17个自治区之一，下辖卢戈、奥伦塞、拉科鲁尼亚和蓬特韦德拉4省，首府為圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉。 加利西亚位于西班牙西北部，南部与葡萄牙接壤，东接阿斯图里亚斯和卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂。
description.zh-TW: 加利西亞自治區是組成西班牙的17個自治區之一，下轄盧戈、奧倫塞、拉科魯尼亞和蓬特韋德拉4省，首府為聖地亞哥-德孔波斯特拉。 加利西亞位於西班牙西北部，南部與葡萄牙接壤，東接阿斯圖里亞斯和卡斯蒂利亞-萊昂。

description.en: Castile and León is an autonomous community of Spain. While a capital has not been explicitly declared, the seats of the executive and legislative powers are set in Valladolid by law, and for all purposes that city serves as the de facto regional capital.
description.zh-CN: 卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂自治区是西班牙的自治区，位于西班牙國土西北方，自治區政府駐地為巴利亚多利德，人口2,510,849。卡斯蒂利亚-莱昂的前身是旧卡斯蒂利亚，如今是西班牙面積最大的自治区，也基本上是欧盟最大的自治区。
description.zh-TW: 卡斯蒂利亞-萊昂自治區是西班牙的自治區，位於西班牙國土西北方，自治區政府駐地為巴利亞多利德，人口2,510,849。卡斯蒂利亞-萊昂的前身是舊卡斯蒂利亞，如今是西班牙面積最大的自治區，也基本上是歐盟最大的自治區。

description.en: West Wales and the Valleys is a former statistical grouping joining western Wales with the South Wales Valleys. It was used to organise regional development funding; its map outline is a statistical geography rather than a distinct cultural border.
description.zh-CN: 西威尔士与山谷地带是一个较早的统计分组，将威尔士西部与南威尔士诸山谷合在一起，曾用于地区发展资金的规划。图中的范围属于统计地理，不应被理解为独立的文化边界。
description.zh-TW: 西威爾士與山谷地帶是一個較早的統計分組，將威爾士西部與南威爾士諸山谷合在一起，曾用於地區發展資金的規劃。圖中的範圍屬於統計地理，不應被理解為獨立的文化邊界。

description.en: North West England is one of nine official regions of England and consists of the ceremonial counties of Cheshire, Cumbria, Greater Manchester, Lancashire and Merseyside. The North West had a population of 7,417,397 in 2021.

description.en: This older Scottish statistical grouping joins Glasgow and the Clyde area with Ayrshire, Lanarkshire and Dumfries and Galloway. It spans the urban west-central belt and the more rural south-west; its historical statistical outline should not be read as a cultural frontier.
description.zh-CN: 这一较早的苏格兰统计分区，将格拉斯哥与克莱德河一带，同艾尔郡、拉纳克郡及邓弗里斯和加洛韦相连。范围横跨西部中央地带的城镇与西南部乡野；图中的旧统计边界不是文化界线。
description.zh-TW: 這一較早的蘇格蘭統計分區，將格拉斯哥與克萊德河一帶，同艾爾郡、拉納克郡及鄧弗里斯和加洛韋相連。範圍橫跨西部中央地帶的城鎮與西南部鄉野；圖中的舊統計邊界不是文化界線。

description.en: The Bahamas, officially the Commonwealth of The Bahamas, is an archipelagic country in the Caribbean located within the Lucayan Archipelago in the Atlantic Ocean. The country comprises 700 islands, and more than 2,500 cays in the Atlantic Ocean, located north of Cuba and north-west of the island of Hispaniola and the Turks and Caicos Islands, southeast of the US state of Florida and east of the Florida Keys.
description.zh-CN: 巴哈馬國，通称巴哈马，是位於大西洋西侧廬卡雅群島上的一个島國，全國包含700座岛屿和珊瑚礁。地處美国佛罗里达礁島群東南面，古巴主島和伊斯帕尼奥拉岛以北，特克斯和凯科斯群岛西北部，絕大多數的領土位於百慕達三角附近。
description.zh-TW: 巴哈馬國，通稱巴哈馬，是位於大西洋西側廬卡雅羣島上的一個島國，全國包含700座島嶼和珊瑚礁。地處美國佛羅里達礁島羣東南面，古巴主島和伊斯帕尼奧拉島以北，特克斯和凱科斯羣島西北部，絕大多數的領土位於百慕達三角附近。

description.en: Louisiana is a state in the Deep South and South Central regions of the United States. It is bordered by Texas to the west, Arkansas to the north, and Mississippi to the east.
description.zh-CN: 路易斯安那州，簡稱路州，是美國的一個州，位於墨西哥灣沿岸。此州以對比強烈的文化、地理景觀著名。

description.en: Mississippi is a state in the Southeastern and Deep South regions of the United States. It borders Tennessee to the north, Alabama to the east, the Gulf of Mexico to the south, Louisiana to the southwest, and Arkansas to the northwest.
description.zh-CN: 密西西比州是美國東南部及深南地區的一個州。北鄰田納西州，東接阿拉巴馬州，南鄰墨西哥灣，西南與路易斯安那州接壤，西北則與阿肯色州相鄰。
description.zh-TW: 密西西比州是美國東南部及深南地區的一個州。北鄰田納西州，東接阿拉巴馬州，南鄰墨西哥灣，西南與路易斯安那州接壤，西北則與阿肯色州相鄰。

photo.alt: The Welsford-Parker Monument, located in Halifax's Old Burying Ground, was erected by citizens in memory of Captain William Parker and Major Augustus Welsford, Nova Scotians who died in the Crimean War. George Lang of Chebucto Grays standing far left in front pair[1] The Acadian Recorder for 21 July reported that: "The afternoon was clear, but uncomfortably warm. A little after 2 o'clock, the procession formed on the Grand Parade. It consisted of all the Halifax and Dartmouth Volunteer Companies, a large number of the Masonic body, and various public officials. These, paraded by bands of music, marched down Barrington Street to the old Cemetery, where detachments of the Regular troops of the garrison were already stationed. The military portion of the assemblage formed a hollow square around the Monument, within which ticket holders were admitted. A large assemblage, especially of the fair sex, were present to witness the proceedings; and the gloomy old grave yard for once presented a gay appearance. The ceremonies commenced with prayer by the Rev. John Scott. His Excellency the Lieutenant Governor, Lord Mulgrave then addressed the assemblage at some length and, in concluding, introduced the Rev. George Hill, the Orator of the day. Mr. Hill's oration was an able and eloquent effort, and is, we understand, to be printed. Major General Charles Trollope also spoke in his usual popular and humorous style, and Rear Admiral Sir Alexander Milne made a few remarks. A great deal of cheering was done and the proceedings concluded by the Volunteer Artillery under the command of Captain Tremain, firing13 minute guns, and by the bands playing and the whole assemblage singing the National Anthem. We find that while the ceremonies were going on, Chase, the clever photographer succeeded in taking an excellent photographic view of the whole scene, a copy of which we have no doubt many people will hasten to secure, as a memento of the day and the event." The reporter for the Acadian Recorder was obviously fascinated by the photographer's activities. Outdoor photography was still a novelty, and this is one of the very first surviving examples taken in Halifax. In the background of the photograph is the Court House, designed by William Thomas of Toronto – brand new then and still standing today.

description.en: Yorkshire and the Humber is one of the nine official regions of England at the first level of ITL for statistical purposes. It is one of the three regions covering Northern England, alongside the North West England and North East England regions, and covers the historic and cultural Yorkshire area.
description.zh-CN: 约克郡-亨伯，英國英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一，涵蓋過去的約克郡以及林肯郡北部。2011年時有人口5,284,000人。
description.zh-TW: 約克郡-亨伯，英國英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一，涵蓋過去的約克郡以及林肯郡北部。2011年時有人口5,284,000人。

description.en: The East Midlands is one of nine official regions of England. It comprises the eastern half of the area traditionally known as the Midlands.
description.zh-CN: 東密德蘭是英國英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一，位於中部以東一帶。
description.zh-TW: 東密德蘭是英國英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一，位於中部以東一帶。

photo.alt: Built to replace All Hallows Church which was destroyed in the Great Fire of Northampton 1675. Charles II gave 1000 tons of timber to rebuild the town, of which 10 per cent was used to build All Saints. The tower of All Hallows survived and was incorporated into Henry Bell's Christopher Wren-influenced new design, which also includes a dome supported on Ionic columns and a barrel-vaulted nave. The church was consecrated in 1680 and the portico was added in 1701, along with a statue of King Charles. On Oak Apple Day each year the statue is adorned with a wreath of oak leaves.

description.en: Eastern Scotland links the Firth of Forth and Fife with the Tay basin, Angus and the eastern Lowlands. This atlas retains the older statistical grouping, including Edinburgh, Stirling and the Scottish Borders, rather than presenting it as a single cultural boundary.
description.zh-CN: 苏格兰东部连接福斯湾、法夫、泰河流域与东部低地。这幅图沿用较早的统计分区，范围包括爱丁堡、斯特灵及苏格兰边区；它并不代表一条单一文化边界。海湾、河谷与低地城镇构成了这一带的主要地理线索。
description.zh-TW: 蘇格蘭東部連接福斯灣、法夫、泰河流域與東部低地。這幅圖沿用較早的統計分區，範圍包括愛丁堡、斯特靈及蘇格蘭邊區；它並不代表一條單一文化邊界。海灣、河谷與低地城鎮構成了這一帶的主要地理線索。

description.en: South East England is one of the nine official regions of England that are in the top level category for statistical purposes. It consists of the nine counties of Berkshire, Buckinghamshire, East Sussex, Hampshire, the Isle of Wight, Kent, Oxfordshire, Surrey and West Sussex.
description.zh-CN: 東南英格蘭是英國英格蘭下轄的9個次級行政區之一。東南區境內包含一座南唐斯國立公園 ，而位於漢普郡和東薩塞克斯郡東岸的七姐妹巖 是在2009年夏天，懸崖風景照片被選為微軟作業系統Windows 7官方桌面壁紙的一部分。

description.en: East Wales is a loosely-defined region of Wales covering its eastern parts, and a former International Territorial Level statistical region of Wales. Various organisations in Wales use various methodologies to sub-divide territory, and most of them use a North–South divide.

description.en: The Highlands and Islands is an area of Scotland broadly covering the Scottish Highlands, plus Orkney, Shetland, and the Hebrides . The Highlands and Islands are sometimes defined as the area to which the Crofters Holdings Act 1886 applied.

description.en: North Eastern Scotland comprises Aberdeen City and Aberdeenshire in this statistical grouping. The North Sea coast and Aberdeen's urban landscape meet the rural hinterland of Aberdeenshire. This grouping is a geographical guide, not a claim of a sharp cultural border.
description.zh-CN: 本图的苏格兰东北部分区由阿伯丁市和阿伯丁郡组成。北海沿岸、阿伯丁的城市景观与阿伯丁郡的乡野腹地在这里相接。这一统计分组用于地理导览，不表示文化在边界处截然分开。
description.zh-TW: 本圖的蘇格蘭東北部分區由阿伯丁市和阿伯丁郡組成。北海沿岸、阿伯丁的城市景觀與阿伯丁郡的鄉野腹地在這裡相接。這一統計分組用於地理導覽，不表示文化在邊界處截然分開。

description.en: Iceland is a Nordic island country between the Arctic Ocean and the North Atlantic Ocean, located on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge between Europe and North America. It is Europe's westernmost and most sparsely populated country.
description.zh-CN: 冰岛是北欧的一个共和制岛国，位于北大西洋和北冰洋交汇处。冰岛国土面积为10.3万平方公里，人口为39万，儘管面積不大，卻是欧洲人口密度最低的国家，也是世界范围内人口密度很小的国家之一。
description.zh-TW: 冰島是北歐的一個共和制島國，位於北大西洋和北冰洋交匯處。冰島國土面積爲10.3萬平方公里，人口爲39萬，儘管面積不大，卻是歐洲人口密度最低的國家，也是世界範圍內人口密度很小的國家之一。

description.en: The Northwest Territories is a territory of Canada. At a land area of approximately 1,127,711.92 square kilometres and a 2026 estimated population of 45,904, it is the second-largest and second-most populous of the three territories in Northern Canada.
description.zh-CN: 西北地區是加拿大一級行政區裡面的三個「地区」之一，面積1,171,918平方公里，但在1999年努那福特自西北地方分離而出之前，面積曾高達3,439,296平方公里，佔了加拿大領土的三分之一。2011年普查時人口為41,462人。
description.zh-TW: 西北地區是加拿大一級行政區裡面的三個「地區」之一，面積1,171,918平方公里，但在1999年努那福特自西北地方分離而出之前，面積曾高達3,439,296平方公里，佔了加拿大領土的三分之一。2011年普查時人口為41,462人。

description.en: Abruzzo , historically also known as Abruzzi, is a region of Southern Italy. It has a population of nearly 1.3 million in an area of 10,831.84 square kilometres .
description.zh-CN: 阿布鲁佐是位于意大利中南部的大区，北与马尔凯交接，拉齐奥位于其西南，东南部是莫利塞大区，东边则是亚得里亚海。该区于1963年从原阿布鲁齐-莫利塞大区中划分出来。
description.zh-TW: 阿布魯佐是位於意大利中南部的大區，北與馬爾凱交接，拉齊奧位於其西南，東南部是莫利塞大區，東邊則是亞得里亞海。該區於1963年從原阿布魯齊-莫利塞大區中劃分出來。

description.en: Molise is an administrative region of Italy that covers 4,460.65 km2 , thus being the second smallest region in the country after Aosta Valley; it is located in southern Italy, and has a population of 285,940 as of 2026. Its regional capital and largest city is Campobasso, which is also the capital of the Province of Campobasso, one of the two provinces that make up Molise.
description.zh-CN: 莫利塞是意大利中部的一个大区，是意大利第二小的大区。大区的前身是阿布魯齊莫利塞區的一部分，现时已分成两个个别的大区。
description.zh-TW: 莫利塞是意大利中部的一個大區，是意大利第二小的大區。大區的前身是阿布魯齊莫利塞區的一部分，現時已分成兩個個別的大區。

description.en: Apulia , also known by its Italian name Puglia , is one of the 20 regions of Italy, located in the southern peninsular section of the country, bordering the Adriatic Sea to the east, the Strait of Otranto and Ionian Sea to the southeast and the Gulf of Taranto to the south. The region comprises 19,540.90 square kilometers , and has 3,865,277 inhabitants as of 2026.
description.zh-CN: 普利亚，也译作阿普利亚，是意大利南部的一个大区，东邻亚得里亚海，东南面临爱奥尼亚海，南面则邻近奥特朗托海峡及塔兰托湾。该区南部知名的萨伦托半岛，组成了意大利「皮靴」的一部分。
description.zh-TW: 普利亞，也譯作阿普利亞，是意大利南部的一個大區，東鄰亞得里亞海，東南面臨愛奧尼亞海，南面則鄰近奧特朗托海峽及塔蘭託灣。該區南部知名的薩倫託半島，組成了意大利「皮靴」的一部分。

photo.credit: NASA / USGS · Landsat WELD · 2000 · Public domain

description.en: Basilicata, also known by its ancient name Lucania, is an administrative region in Southern Italy, bordering on Campania to the west, Apulia to the north and east, and Calabria to the south. It has two coastlines: a 30-kilometre stretch on the Gulf of Policastro between Campania and Calabria, and a longer coastline along the Gulf of Taranto between Calabria and Apulia.
description.zh-CN: 巴西利卡塔亦称卢卡尼亚，是意大利南部的一个大区，东、西分别与坎帕尼亚、普利亚相邻，南边是卡拉布里亚，有小段海岸线连接第勒尼安海，另一段则在东南方—塔兰托湾—与伊奥尼亚海相连。全区面积9,995平方公里，人口597,768，人口密度为60人/平方公里。
description.zh-TW: 巴西利卡塔亦稱盧卡尼亞，是意大利南部的一個大區，東、西分別與坎帕尼亞、普利亞相鄰，南邊是卡拉布里亞，有小段海岸線連接第勒尼安海，另一段則在東南方—塔蘭託灣—與伊奧尼亞海相連。全區面積9,995平方公里，人口597,768，人口密度爲60人/平方公里。

description.en: Calabria is a region in Southern Italy. It is a peninsula bordered by the Basilicata region to the north, the Ionian Sea to the east, the Strait of Messina to the southwest, which separates it from Sicily, and the Tyrrhenian Sea to the west.
description.zh-CN: 卡拉布里亚，從前稱為“布鲁提乌姆”，是意大利南部的一個大区，包含了那不勒斯以南像「足尖」的意大利半島。大区北鄰巴西利卡塔大区，西南鄰西西里自治区，西鄰第勒尼安海，及東鄰伊奧尼亞海。
description.zh-TW: 卡拉布里亞，從前稱為“布魯提烏姆”，是意大利南部的一個大區，包含了那不勒斯以南像「足尖」的意大利半島。大區北鄰巴西利卡塔大區，西南鄰西西里自治區，西鄰第勒尼安海，及東鄰伊奧尼亞海。

description.en: Campania is an administrative region of Italy, located in the south of the country; most of it is in the southwestern portion of the Italian Peninsula , but it also includes the small Phlegraean Islands – Ischia, Procida, Vivara, and Nisida – and the island of Capri. The capital is Naples.
description.zh-CN: 坎帕尼亚是意大利南部的一个大区，西北临拉齐奥大区，北界临莫利塞大区，东北临普利亚大区，东界临巴斯利卡塔大区及西临第勒尼安海。大区面积13,590平方公里，拥有5,725,098人口。
description.zh-TW: 坎帕尼亞是意大利南部的一個大區，西北臨拉齊奧大區，北界臨莫利塞大區，東北臨普利亞大區，東界臨巴斯利卡塔大區及西臨第勒尼安海。大區面積13,590平方公里，擁有5,725,098人口。

description.en: Lazio or Latium is one of the 20 administrative regions of Italy. Situated in the central peninsular section of the country, it has 5,709,444 inhabitants and a GDP of more than €212 billion per year, making it the country's second most populated region and second largest regional economy after Lombardy.
description.zh-CN: 拉齐奥是意大利的一个大区，其政府所在地为罗马。
description.zh-TW: 拉齊奧是意大利的一個大區，其政府所在地爲羅馬。

description.en: Tuscany is a region of central Italy. With a population of 3,659,222 in an area of 22,987.04 square kilometres , it is the 9th most populous and 5th-largest region of Italy.
description.zh-CN: 托斯卡纳是意大利一个大区，拉齐奥位于其南，翁布里亚位于其东，艾米利亚-罗马涅和利古里亚在其北，西濒第勒尼安海。其首府为佛罗伦萨。
description.zh-TW: 托斯卡納是意大利一個大區，拉齊奧位於其南，翁布里亞位於其東，艾米利亞-羅馬涅和利古里亞在其北，西瀕第勒尼安海。其首府爲佛羅倫薩。

description.en: The Valencian Community is an autonomous community of Spain. It is the fourth most populous Spanish autonomous community after Andalusia, Catalonia and the Community of Madrid with more than 5 million inhabitants.
description.zh-CN: 華倫西亞自治区是西班牙的一個自治區，位於西班牙東南部。1238年至1707年曾為瓦倫西亞王國。
description.zh-TW: 華倫西亞自治區是西班牙的一個自治區，位於西班牙東南部。1238年至1707年曾為瓦倫西亞王國。

description.en: Murcia is a city in south-eastern Spain, and the capital and most populous city of the autonomous community of the Region of Murcia. As of 2024, with a population of 479,405, it is the 7th-largest city in Spain.

description.en: Asturias, officially the Principality of Asturias, is an autonomous community in northwestern Spain. It is coextensive with the province of Asturias and contains some of the territory that was part of the larger Kingdom of Asturias in the Middle Ages.

description.en: Pays de la Loire is one of the eighteen administrative regions of France, located on the country's Atlantic coast. It was created in the 1950s to serve as a zone of influence for its capital and most populated city, Nantes, one of a handful of French "balancing metropolises" .

description.zh-TW: 盧瓦爾河地區大區是法國西部一個大區，西鄰大西洋，處於盧瓦爾河下游和及河口地區，法國大革命時期曾是保皇派叛亂的重要區域。它是1950年代創建的大區之一，作爲其首府的影響區，南特是少數所謂的“平衡大都會”之一。

description.en: Brittany is a peninsula, historical region and cultural area in the north-west of modern France, covering the western part of what was known as Armorica in Roman Gaul. It became an independent kingdom and then a duchy before being united with the Kingdom of France in 1532 as a province governed as a separate nation under the crown.

description.en: Bremen , officially the Free Hanseatic City of Bremen , is the smallest and least populous of Germany's 16 states. It is informally called Land Bremen , although the term is sometimes used in official contexts.

The Hamburg Metropolitan Region has a population of over 5.1 million and is the tenth-largest metropolitan region by GDP in the European Union.

description.en: Greenland is an autonomous territory of the Kingdom of Denmark and is the largest of the kingdom's three constituent parts by land area, the others being Denmark proper and the Faroe Islands. Citizens of Greenland are citizens of Denmark.

description.en: Bermuda is a British Overseas Territory in the North Atlantic Ocean. The closest land outside the territory is in the US state of North Carolina, about 1,035 km to the west-northwest.

photo.alt: 1904 view of eastern Hamilton Harbour and Paget Parish from Fort Hamilton, Prospect Camp, en:Bermuda (the fort is located in Pembroke Parish, though most of Prospect Camp is within Devonshire Parish). The East Broadway road is hidden at the foot of the slope below the fort, on the northern shore of the harbour. The roof of the house at centre on the northern shore belonged to the landmark "Queen of The East", allowed to become derelict by its owners, despite being a listed property, and demolished in 2016 to make way for a new development. On the opposing southern shore of the harbour, a number of houses are shown on Pomander Road, most of which still exist, with the notable exception being the large building on the landward side of the road at centre, which was the "Pomander Gate" guesthouse. Its site is now occupied by a new build housing development and a tennis club of the same name. Four decades before The Blight,[1][2][3][4][5] the Bermuda cedar cloaked ridgeline in the background includes the highpoint known as "Trimingham Hill" where Princess Louise occupied a private residence during the winter of 1883.

description.en: The Canary Islands or Canaries are an archipelago in the Atlantic Ocean and the southernmost autonomous community of Spain, located about 100 kilometres off the northwest coast of Africa. The archipelago has a population of over 2.2 million inhabitants, making it the most populous overseas special territory of the European Union.

description.en: Malta, officially the Republic of Malta, is an island country located in the central Mediterranean Sea. It consists of a number of islands, of which Malta and Gozo are the two main ones—south of Italy, east of Tunisia, and north of Libya.

description.en: Sicily , officially the Sicilian Region, is an island in the central Mediterranean Sea and one of the twenty regions of Italy, situated south of the Italian Peninsula in continental Europe. description.en: Jersey , officially the Bailiwick of Jersey, is an autonomous and self-governing British Crown Dependency in Northwestern Europe 14 miles off the Cotentin Peninsula of north-west France. At 45 square miles , the main island, Jersey, is the largest of the Channel Islands.

description.en: Åland is an autonomous and demilitarised region of Finland. Receiving its autonomy in 1920, it is the smallest region of Finland by both area and population , constituting 0.51% of Finland's land area and 0.54% of its population.

description.en: The Faroe Islands , also known as the Faroes, are an archipelago in the North Atlantic Ocean and a rigsdel of the Kingdom of Denmark. Located between Iceland, Norway, and the Hebrides and Shetland isles of Scotland, the islands have a population of 55,466 as of July 2026 and a land area of 1,393 km2 .

description.en: Prince Edward Island is an island province of Canada. It is the smallest province by both land area and population, but has the highest population density in Canada.

description.en: Colorado is a landlocked state in the Mountain West subregion of the Western United States. It is part of the Southwestern United States, sharing the Four Corners region with Arizona, New Mexico, and Utah.

description.zh-TW: 科羅拉多州，簡稱科州，是美國西部的一個州，此州最著名的是擁有洛磯山脈的最高峯，地形從東側的平原陡然升高為西側峻嶺，地理景觀十分壯麗。該州首府兼最大城為丹佛。

description.en: South Dakota is a landlocked state in the Upper Midwest region of the United States. It is also part of the Great Plains.
description.zh-CN: 南達科他州，簡稱南達州，是美國中西部平原上地勢較高的一州，過去曾是美國印地安人蘇族中拉科他族的聚落所在。南達科他州在1889年11月2日加入美國聯邦，也是在同一天被命名的。
description.zh-TW: 南達科他州，簡稱南達州，是美國中西部平原上地勢較高的一州，過去曾是美國印地安人蘇族中拉科他族的聚落所在。南達科他州在1889年11月2日加入美國聯邦，也是在同一天被命名的。

description.en: Nebraska is a landlocked state in the Great Plains and Midwestern region of the United States. It borders South Dakota to the north; Wyoming to the west; Colorado to the southwest; Kansas to the south; and Missouri to the southeast and Iowa to the east, both across the Missouri River.
description.zh-CN: 內布拉斯加州是美國中西部大平原区的一州，它的名稱來自美國原住民中的吉韋雷語，意為平順之水。該州有普拉特河貫穿整州。

description.en: Greater London is an administrative area in England, coterminous with the London region, containing most of the continuous urban area of London. It contains 33 local government districts: the 32 London boroughs, which form a ceremonial county also called Greater London, and the City of London, which is a separate ceremonial county.
description.zh-CN: 大倫敦，位於英國英格蘭東南部，是英格蘭下屬的一級行政區劃之一，範圍大致包含英國首都倫敦首都直轄市與其周圍的衛星城鎮所組成的都會區。行政上，該區域是依據1965年施行的《1963年倫敦政府法令》設置，其下包含倫敦市與32個倫敦自治市，共33個次級行政區。
description.zh-TW: 大倫敦，位於英國英格蘭東南部，是英格蘭下屬的一級行政區劃之一，範圍大致包含英國首都倫敦首都直轄市與其周圍的衛星城鎮所組成的都會區。行政上，該區域是依據1965年施行的《1963年倫敦政府法令》設置，其下包含倫敦市與32個倫敦自治市，共33個次級行政區。

description.en: Wisconsin is a state in the Upper Midwest and Great Lakes regions of the United States. It borders Minnesota to the west, Iowa to the southwest, Illinois to the south, Lake Michigan to the east, Michigan to the northeast, and Lake Superior to the north.
description.zh-CN: 威斯康辛州，又译威斯康辛州或威斯康森州，簡稱威州，是美國中北部的一個州，緊臨五大湖區。該州的西邊為明尼蘇達州，西南邊為愛荷華州，南邊為伊利諾州，東邊為密西根湖，東北邊為密西根上半島，北邊為蘇必略湖。
description.zh-TW: 威斯康辛州，又譯威斯康辛州或威斯康森州，簡稱威州，是美國中北部的一個州，緊臨五大湖區。該州的西邊為明尼蘇達州，西南邊為愛荷華州，南邊為伊利諾州，東邊為密西根湖，東北邊為密西根上半島，北邊為蘇必略湖。

description.en: Illinois is a state in the Midwestern United States. It borders on Lake Michigan to its northeast, the Wabash and Ohio rivers to its south, and the Mississippi River generally to its west.
description.zh-CN: 伊利諾州，簡稱伊州，是一個位于美国中西部的州，州名源自曾在此居住的伊利尼維克印第安人部落。「Illinois」這個名字就是法國殖民者根據此部落名稱變形而得來的。
description.zh-TW: 伊利諾州，簡稱伊州，是一個位於美國中西部的州，州名源自曾在此居住的伊利尼維克印第安人部落。「Illinois」這個名字就是法國殖民者根據此部落名稱變形而得來的。

description.en: Kentucky , officially the Commonwealth of Kentucky, is a landlocked state in the Southeastern region of the United States. It borders Illinois, Indiana, and Ohio to the north, West Virginia to the northeast, Virginia to the east, Tennessee to the south, and Missouri to the west.
description.zh-CN: 肯塔基州是美国中东部的一个州，面積104,749平方公里，在全國排名第37位。2005年人口4,041,769人，全國排名第26位。
description.zh-TW: 肯塔基州是美國中東部的一個州，面積104,749平方公里，在全國排名第37位。2005年人口4,041,769人，全國排名第26位。

description.en: Arkansas is a landlocked state in the West South Central region of the Southern United States. It borders Missouri to the north, Tennessee and Mississippi to the east, Louisiana to the south, Texas to the southwest, and Oklahoma to the west.
description.zh-CN: 阿肯色州，是美国南部的一个州份，位處密西西比河中下游，北接密苏里州，西界俄克拉荷马州，南邻路易斯安那州，西南与得克萨斯州接壤，东隔密西西比河与田纳西州和密西西比州相望。其面积137,539平方公里，在五十個州內列第29位。
description.zh-TW: 阿肯色州，是美國南部的一個州份，位處密西西比河中下游，北接密蘇里州，西界俄克拉荷馬州，南鄰路易斯安那州，西南與得克薩斯州接壤，東隔密西西比河與田納西州和密西西比州相望。其面積137,539平方公里，在五十個州內列第29位。

description.en: Tennessee , officially the State of Tennessee, is a landlocked state in the Southeastern region of the United States. It borders Kentucky to the north, Virginia to the northeast, North Carolina to the east, Georgia, Alabama, and Mississippi to the south, Arkansas to the southwest, and Missouri to the northwest.
description.zh-CN: 田纳西州，位于美国南方，首府及最大城市為納許維爾，是美國音樂聖地，也是美国乡村音乐的中心。其他著名城市还有孟菲斯、诺克斯维尔和查塔努加。
description.zh-TW: 田納西州，位於美國南方，首府及最大城市為納許維爾，是美國音樂聖地，也是美國鄉村音樂的中心。其他著名城市還有孟菲斯、諾克斯維爾和查塔努加。

description.en: West Virginia is a mountainous, landlocked state in the Southern and Mid-Atlantic regions of the United States. It is bordered by Pennsylvania and Maryland to the northeast, Virginia to the southeast, Kentucky to the southwest, and Ohio to the northwest.
description.zh-CN: 西維珍尼亞州，簡稱西弗州，是美國東部的一個州，有著名的阿帕拉契山脈，別稱為「山脈之州」。 西維珍尼亞是在美國南北戰爭時期由當時的維吉尼亞州西北部的48郡因反對脫離美利堅合眾國所分裂出來的。
description.zh-TW: 西維珍尼亞州，簡稱西弗州，是美國東部的一個州，有著名的阿帕拉契山脈，別稱為「山脈之州」。 西維珍尼亞是在美國南北戰爭時期由當時的維吉尼亞州西北部的48郡因反對脫離美利堅合眾國所分裂出來的。

description.en: Indiana is a state in the Midwestern region of the United States. It borders Lake Michigan to the northwest, Michigan to the north and northeast, Ohio to the east, the Ohio River and Kentucky to the south and southeast, and the Wabash River and Illinois to the west.
description.zh-CN: 印第安纳州是美国中西部的一个州，首府及最大城市為印第安纳波利斯。印第安纳州是美国50个州中按面积第38大，按人口第17大的州。
description.zh-TW: 印第安納州是美國中西部的一個州，首府及最大城市為印第安納波利斯。印第安納州是美國50個州中按面積第38大，按人口第17大的州。

description.en: Umbria is a region of central Italy. It includes Lake Trasimeno and Marmore Falls, and is crossed by the Tiber.
description.zh-CN: 翁布里亚是意大利的一个大区，位于意大利中心，首府佩鲁贾。面积8,456平方公里——其中佩鲁贾省6,334平方公里；特尔尼省2,122平方公里——是意大利面積第五小的大区，也是意大利唯一不临海也不与外国接壤的大区。
description.zh-TW: 翁布里亞是意大利的一個大區，位於意大利中心，首府佩魯賈。面積8,456平方公里——其中佩魯賈省6,334平方公里；特爾尼省2,122平方公里——是意大利麪積第五小的大區，也是意大利唯一不臨海也不與外國接壤的大區。

description.en: Centre-Val de Loire , or simply Centre as it was known until 2015, is one of the eighteen administrative regions of France and one of five without a coastline. It straddles the middle Loire Valley in the interior of the country, encompassing six departments , with a population of 2,572,853 as of 2018.
description.zh-CN: 中央-盧瓦爾河谷是法国中部的一個大區。中部地区处在风景秀丽的卢瓦尔河谷地区，很久以前便是法国王室的直辖地，和法兰西岛一样是法语的发源地，有人认为这一地区有着“最标准的法语”。
description.zh-TW: 中央-盧瓦爾河谷是法國中部的一個大區。中部地區處在風景秀麗的盧瓦爾河谷地區，很久以前便是法國王室的直轄地，和法蘭西島一樣是法語的發源地，有人認爲這一地區有着“最標準的法語”。

description.en: The Île-de-France is the most populous of the eighteen regions of France, with an official estimated population of 12,271,794 residents on 1 January 2023. Containing the capital city of France, Paris, it is located in the north-central part of the country and often called the Paris Region .
description.zh-CN: 法兰西岛是法国本土13个大区之一，也是法國首都巴黎的首都圈。其以巴黎为中心，包括巴黎省、上塞纳省、塞纳-圣但尼省、马恩河谷省、塞纳-马恩省、伊夫林省、埃松省和瓦兹河谷省，共计1276个市镇。
description.zh-TW: 法蘭西島是法國本土13個大區之一，也是法國首都巴黎的首都圈。其以巴黎爲中心，包括巴黎省、上塞納省、塞納-聖但尼省、馬恩河谷省、塞納-馬恩省、伊夫林省、埃松省和瓦茲河谷省，共計1276個市鎮。

description.en: Madrid is the capital and largest city of Spain. It had a population of over 3.4 million in the city proper in 2025, and a metropolitan area population of approximately 6.8 million.
description.zh-CN: 马德里是西班牙首都及最大都市，也是马德里自治区首府，其位置處於西班牙國土中部，曼薩納雷斯河貫穿市區。2023年，其GDP约为2930亿欧元，市內人口約340萬，都会区人口則約627.1萬，均佔西班牙首位。
description.zh-TW: 馬德里是西班牙首都及最大都市，也是馬德里自治區首府，其位置處於西班牙國土中部，曼薩納雷斯河貫穿市區。2023年，其GDP約爲2930億歐元，市內人口約340萬，都會區人口則約627.1萬，均佔西班牙首位。
